<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-use-custom-questions | Nav: How to Use Custom Questions | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Use Custom Questions

The **Custom Questions** feature is a great way for you to collect specific information you need from your donors, guests or participants! It allows you to collect information in the form of a **Text Box** , **Dropdown Menu** , or **Checkboxes** . This feature also allows you to attach a **Waiver** to your fundraiser.  
**Custom Questions** are a great way for your fundraising team to collect additional data points about your donors. Looking to find out if a social media campaign for your fundraiser was successful?

Ask your donors! - "*How did you hear about us?"*is one of the most commonly used, and effective examples of a custom checkout question for existing CrowdChange partners.

**Custom Questions** can be toggled on from the **Purchase Options**section when creating a fundraiser.  
![image-20250723-154920.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-154920.png)

Once your fundraiser is created, click**Manage My Fundraiser** in the upper right-hand corner of the page.  
![image-20250723-154955.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-154955.png)

Then go to **Custom Questions** on the left sidebar.  
![image-20250723-155330.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-155330.png)

From the **Custom Questions** page, click **Add** **Question** under **Questions** to create your first one.  
![image-20250723-155618.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-155618.png)  
![image-20250723-160524.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-160524.png)

Click **Save** in the bottom right corner to confirm.  
If you require the ability to set**Custom ID's** for each question (as shown in the image above), reach out to your Partner Success Representative for this feature to be enabled on your site.

*** ** * ** ***

The available types of Custom Questions are as follows:

* **Text**

  * The **Text** option allows users to enter specific information in response to a question you ask.

    Within the **Text** option, you may select a format: **Freeform text** , **Phone number** , **Date** or **Number**.

* **Checkboxes**

  * The **Checkboxes**option allows users to select from a pre-determined list of answers to your question, which can include the selection of multiple answers.

* **Dropdown**

  * The **Dropdown**option allows users to select an answer to your question from a list that you have determined. In this situation, users are only able to select one option.

* **Waiver**

  * If your event requires a **Waiver**that your participants must agree to, this function allows you to insert the content of your waiver into a box that the user will be prompted to view and agree to.

* **Multi-Line Text**

  * The **Multi-Line Text**option works the same way as the standard Text Box \> Freeform Text option, but allows for more detailed information to be entered via multi-line functionality.

Toggling on the **Mark as Required** checkbox means that users must answer this custom question in order to complete their purchase or donation. This is highly recommended for an event where, for example, a waiver is required for persons to participate.

The '**Show this field on**' section allows you to determine on which pages (General Donations, Team Pages, and/or Personal Pages) the question is presented to the donor.  
![image-20250723-160737.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-160737.png)

The '**Show this field when these options are selected**' section helps to specify even further, in what circumstances the question will show up.

For example, you can ensure that your question is always asked to those who are purchasing tickets, but not to those who are simply donating. This is helpful if you are asking questions specific to one or some of the features you have decided to use.  
![image-20250723-160808.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-160808.png)  
Note that answers to questions which are set to '**Repeat for each registrant** ' will appear in the Excel version of the[**Registration Report**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Registrations-Report.2022834323.html). Within this report, go to your fundraiser's specific tab (named: Fundraiser ID - Fundraiser Name), and scroll all the way to the right, to the last columns.

Answers to regular custom checkout questions will appear within the [**Admin Donations Report**](how-to-access-the-admin-donations-report.md).

## **Conditional Questions**

CrowdChange offers the ability to ask **Conditional Questions** at check-out.

There are two (2) types of Conditional Questions:

* Those which will only show up if a certain answer is given to a previous question.

  * For example, a question like '*Rare, Medium Rare or Well-Done?* ' could appear after the response '*Steak* ' is given for '*What is your preferred meal option?*'.

* Those which will only show up if specific Purchase options are added to the cart.

  * For example, the question '*What size are you?*' could be asked when a T-shirt purchase option is added to the cart, and registrants could be asked specific sets of custom questions depending on the registration option they select (E.g. Youth vs. Adult vs. Senior registration).

### To create a conditional question linked to a specific answer to a previous question:

Start by creating both questions you would like your donors to answer - the **Parent** question, and the **Child** question. The Parent question must be either a **Single Selection** or **Multiple Choice** question - it cannot be a **Text** or **Waiver**question. You can set the Child question to appear only if a specific answer is given to the Parent question. Please follow the steps below to set this up:

1. Create both the Parent and Child question.

2. Ensure that these questions are set to appear on the same pages (In the '*Show this field on* ' section), and with the same purchase options (In the '*Show this field when these options are selected*' section).

3. On the Child question, toggle on **Set Conditions**.

4. Within the **Type** dropdown that appears, select **Custom question** . From here, within the **Field name** dropdown, you can select the (Parent) question which the Child question should be linked to, and use the **Answer**dropdown to set which answer(s) should cause the Child question to appear.

5. Be sure to click **Save**when you are finished.

![setconditions.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/setconditions.png)

### To create a conditional question linked to specific purchase options being added to cart:

In this scenario there is no need for a Parent and Child question. Simply add the desired purchase options to your fundraiser and go to **Manage Fundraiser → Custom Questions**to create your questions.

Follow the simple steps below to set this up:

1. Ensure your desired purchase options have been created at the fundraiser level.

2. Go to **Manage Fundraiser → Custom Questions**.

3. Click **Add Question**.

4. Enter the required information and click **Set conditions**.

5. Within the **Type** dropdown that appears, select **Purchase options** . From here, within the **Select option** dropdown, you can select the type/category of purchase option you are looking for, then the specific option(s) within the dropdown on the right.

6. Be sure to click **Save**when you are finished.

![options23.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/options23.png)

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-edit-answers-to-custom-questions-on-user-re | Nav: How to Use Custom Questions > How to Edit Answers to Custom Questions on user request (Multi-Registration sites only) | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Edit Answers to Custom Questions on user request (Multi-Registration sites only)

**N.B.**This feature only applies for transactions made to fundraisers with our multi-registration flow.

If a donor or registrant makes a mistake while answering your custom checkout questions, or simply changes their mind, don't worry! You have the ability as an Admin user to make the adjustments in CrowdChange.

From the Admin Registration Report, each registration listed will have a **Change** button in the rightmost column, which you can click on to adjust answers to custom checkout questions. You may also adjust registrant **name** ('username' in Admin Reports),**display name** (in public Donation Lists), edit any displayed **comment** and set whether to show or hide the transaction **amount**.

Follow these simple steps to change answers to custom questions:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Registration Report**using the left sidebar.

4. Click the **Change**button next to a registration.

   ![299307.png](../assets/how-to-edit-answers-to-custom-questions-on-user-re/299307.png)
5. Scroll down to the custom checkout questions (last in the list) and make your desired adjustments.

6. Click **Save**to confirm your changes.

   ![edit2.png](../assets/how-to-edit-answers-to-custom-questions-on-user-re/edit2.png)

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-create-an-ecards-store | Nav: How to Create an eCards Store | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Create an eCards Store

In this tutorial, you will learn how to create your first **eCards Store**! eCards are an awesome, easy-to-use feature of CrowdChange which brings added value and engagement to your online fundraising portal.  
eCards can be sent via Email, postal Mail or SMS.  
![image-20231123-181300.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-181300.png)

## How to Enable eCards when creating your fundraiser

To create an eCards store, you must first enable the eCards feature on a fundraiser - you can do so while creating (or editing) a fundraiser. Here are the steps to enable eCards while creating a fundraiser.

1. From the homepage of your CrowdChange site, click**Start a Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![image-20231123-152708.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-152708.png)
2. Fill out all necessary information about your fundraiser on the **General Info** page.

   ![image-20231123-152830.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-152830.png)
3. Scroll down and click **Next** to continue to the **Additional Settings**page.

   ![nxt.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/nxt.png)
4. On the **Additional Settings** page, enable **eCards** under **Advanced Features**.

   ![image-20231123-153512.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-153512.png)
5. Scroll down and click **Create Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20231123-153544.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-153544.png)

## How to Set Up eCards on your fundraiser

Once eCards is enabled on your fundraiser, the next step is to configure eCards settings and add cards.

1. From your eCards fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![image-20240820-201302.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20240820-201302.png)
2. Click **Purchase Options** on the left sidebar.

3. Click **eCards/Tribute cards**.

4. Scroll down and click **Purchase settings**to configure eCards settings and delivery methods on your fundraiser.

   ![image-20240820-201509.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20240820-201509.png)
   1. *Please note that if you leave '* ***Require card purchase to complete checkout*** *' un-checked, donors will be able to complete general donations without adding an eCard. Generally we recommend requiring card (eCard) purchases on eCard Store fundraisers.*

      ![image-20240820-201612.png](/__attachments/a_b189d800cc2b81e8fae3eac5172c86dfd1c32f3b8742c5080106b66140fdfe17/image-20240820-201612.png?cb=26adafa76201cd3e6f8cedfe5c135400)
5. Click **Save**to confirm your choices.

6. Click**Create eCard** to add your first card.

   ![image-20240820-201803.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20240820-201803.png)
7. **Name** the card, set a **price** , enter **tags** for easy sorting and upload your **image**.

   ![image-20231123-154624.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-154624.png)
8. Click **Save**to create the card.

   ![image-20231123-154707.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-154707.png)
9. You may return to the eCards menu at any time to **add** , **edit, remove** or **preview**eCards.

## Adding the eCards block to your fundraiser

Next we recommend adding the eCards block to your fundraiser, which allows you to display select eCards on the main fundraiser page, providing a more seamless experience for potential purchasers.

1. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

   ![manage.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/manage.png)
2. Click **Design your Fundraiser**.

   ![design it.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/design_it.png)
3. Scroll down, hover over an existing block, and click the '**+**' icon.

4. Select **eCards block**.

   ![ecardsz.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/ecardsz.png)
5. The eCards block will appear, showing any eCards you have already added.

6. Click the **pencil**(edit) icon if desired to edit the cards shown, or adjust block colours and text.

   ![image-20231123-174630.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-174630.png)

## How to Edit the eCards Email Template

If you would like to change the default text of the eCard emails sent to recipients, follow these steps:

1. Go to your eCards fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

2. Click**Automated email templates** on the left sidebar.

3. Click on **eCard Email** and toggle on '**I want to use my own text'.**

4. Edit the default text as desired and click **Save**.

   ![savezz.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/savezz.png)

## How to View the eCards Report

You can re-send, re-schedule, and/or cancel eCards from your **eCards Report**.

1. Go to your eCards fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

2. Go to**Reports →** **eCards Report**.

3. From the **eCards Report**you can see all sent and pending cards, delivery status, and you have the ability to update scheduled delivery dates, cancel, resend or preview cards, change recipient emails, and more.

   ![reportz.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/reportz.png)

4. Click the **Download** button to download the Excel spreadsheet version of this report.

## A Note on Tax Receipting

Please note that **Tax Receipts** will only be issued for eCard purchases if the following are true:

* Tax Receipts have been enabled in the eCard store / fundraiser settings.

* The transaction amount meets the minimum amount set either at the site-wide, or fundraiser level.

To learn more about Tax Receipts, see [**Tax Receipts \& Eligibility**](tax-receipts-eligibility.md)

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-use-tribute-cards | Nav: How to Use Tribute Cards | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Use Tribute Cards

In this tutorial, you will learn how to set up and use **Tribute Cards**. The Tribute Cards feature allows you to create Memorial Fund / "In Memory Of" type fundraisers, or simply add tribute giving to your fundraiser.  
Tribute Cards can be sent via Email, postal Mail or SMS.  
![image-20231124-155840.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-155840.png)

## How to Enable Tribute Cards when Creating your Fundraiser

To use Tribute Cards on a fundraiser, you must enable the required feature while creating or editing it.

Here are the steps to enable Tribute Cards while creating a new fundraiser.

1. From the homepage of your CrowdChange site, click**Start a Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![image-20231123-152708.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231123-152708.png)
2. Fill out all necessary information about your fundraiser on the **General Info** page.

   ![image-20231124-151234.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-151234.png)
3. Scroll down and click **Next** to continue to the **Additional Settings**page.

   ![nxt.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/nxt.png)
4. On the **Additional Settings** page, enable **eCards** under **Advanced Features** , and select **Tribute Cards** from the dropdown that appears.

   ![image-20231124-151322.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-151322.png)
5. Scroll down and click **Create Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20231123-153544.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231123-153544.png)

If creating an 'In Memory Of' / 'In Memoriam' style fundraiser, we recommend enabling personal fundraising pages as well so that donors can create their own pages in memory of their loved ones.

## How to Set Up Tribute Cards on your Fundraiser

Once the feature is enabled on your fundraiser, the next step is to configure your Tribute Cards purchase settings and add each of your Tribute Card options.

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![managefundraiserbro.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/managefundraiserbro.png)
2. Go to **Purchase Options** on the left sidebar, then **Tribute Cards**.

3. Click**Purchase settings**to configure Tribute Cards settings and delivery methods on your fundraiser.

   ![image-20240820-202732.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20240820-202732.png)
   1. *Please note that if you leave '* ***Require card purchase to complete checkout*** *' un-checked, donors will be able to complete general donations without adding a Tribute Card. Generally we recommend requiring card (Tribute Card) purchases on Tribute Giving fundraisers.*

      ![image-20240820-202757.png](/__attachments/a_a839689bfbf416c3c2b715190629d10c2a243535326a0fbc7ac9273b5c845566/image-20240820-202757.png?cb=a4466d14a4e4cf49509aacee946bae6d)
4. Click **Save**to confirm your choices.

5. Click**Create Tribute Card**to add your first card.

   ![image-20240820-202832.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20240820-202832.png)
6. **Name** the card, set a **Dedication type** (eg: In Memory of, In Honour of, In Celebration of, or custom), enter your **Dedication text** ,and upload an **Image**. For example:

   ![image-20231124-154223.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-154223.png)
7. Click **Save**in the bottom right to create the card.

8. You may return to the Tribute Cards menu at any time to **add** , **edit, remove** or **preview**cards.

Please note that **Tax Receipts** will only be issued for Tribute Card purchases if the following are true:

* Tax Receipts have been enabled in the Tribute Cards store / fundraiser settings.

* The transaction amount meets the minimum amount set either at the site-wide, or fundraiser level.

To learn more about Tax Receipts, see [**Tax Receipts \& Eligibility**](tax-receipts-eligibility.md)

## How to Edit the Tribute Card Email Template

If you would like to change the default text of the Tribute Card email, follow these steps:

1. Go to your Tribute Cards fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

2. Go to**Automated email templates** on the left sidebar.

3. Click on **Tribute Card Email** and toggle on '**I want to use my own text'.**

4. Edit the default text as desired and click **Save**.

   ![testimg.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/testimg.png)

## Tribute Giving - Live Partner Examples

Here are a few examples of tribute giving fundraisers created by our partners:

* **Israel Cancer Research Fund - Tribute Cards:** <http://icrf.crowdchange.ca/1078>

  * Sending a card is tied to completing your donation.

* **Cystic Fibrosis Canada - In Memory:** <https://cysticfibrosistribute.crowdchange.ca/2196>

  * Uses Peer to Peer functionality, allowing supporters to create memorial pages on their own.

* **Kelowna General Hospital Foundation - Donate Today:** <http://kghfoundation.crowdchange.co/14594>

  * Gives donors the option for a **general** gift, an 'In honour of' / 'In memory of' gift **without** a card or an 'In honour of' / 'In memory of' gift **with**a card.

*** ** * ** ***

To create a **Donate Today** page like the Kelowna General Hospital Foundation example above:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site's homepage and click **Start a Fundraiser**.

2. Fill out the **General Info** page, then click **Next**.

3. On the **Additional Settings** page, under **Advanced Features** , toggle on **eCards** and select **Tribute Cards** from the dropdown that appears.

4. Click **Create Fundraiser**at the bottom of the page.

5. From the fundraiser's main page, click**Manage Fundraiser** in the top right corner

6. Go to**Purchase Options → eCards/Tribute Cards**.

7. Click **Purchase Settings.**

8. Select **Require card purchase to complete checkout** if you'd like to make sending a card mandatory when completing a donation. Leaving this unchecked will give donors the option to add a card to their donation if they so desire - as in the KGH example: <http://kghfoundation.crowdchange.co/14594/donate>.

9. Select the delivery methods you would like to offer to your donors when sending a card (**Email** , **Mail** and/or **SMS**Text Message).

10. Click **Save** to confirm.

11. Next, click **Create Tribute Card** to begin adding your Tribute Card options.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-create-custom-fundraiser-links | Nav: How to Create Custom Fundraiser Links | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Create Custom Fundraiser Links

**Custom Fundraiser Links** are a great way to share your fundraiser using a link that is memorable and easy for potential donors. This feature creates a custom domain link that is specific to your fundraiser.

To access the **Custom Links**menu, follow these steps:

1. Log in to a CrowdChange account with **Admin**permissions.

2. Click **Profile → Admin** in the upper right-hand corner of the screen.

3. Click **Fundraisers Settings →** **Custom Links** on the left sidebar.

   ![custom links.png](../assets/how-to-create-custom-fundraiser-links/custom_links.png)

On the **Custom Links**page that appears, you can create a custom link which is tied to a specific fundraiser.  
![newrule.png](../assets/how-to-create-custom-fundraiser-links/newrule.png)

1. Click on **Create New Rule**.

2. Enter the **Page Alias**. This is how your custom link will read. Try to make this easy for your users to remember.

3. Search or scroll through the list of fundraisers, and select the **Fundraiser** you would like to link to.

4. Click **Save**.

The link will be listed on your **Custom Links** page as shown above. To remove it, click the **Trash Can** icon.

There's no limit to how many of these links your CrowdChange site can have, so create as many as you need!  
**Custom Fundraiser Links** will appear when used in any forward-facing communication to your donor base (i.e. email, social media posts, etc.), however, when donors land on the connected fundraiser the custom ending will be removed and replaced by the CrowdChange Fundraiser ID.

For example,**https://kevindev.crowdchange.dev/bingo** will revert back to **https://kevindev.crowdchange.dev/7722** when a donor lands on the fundraiser.

================================================================================

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-create-custom-urls-for-team-personal-pages- | Nav: How to Create Custom URLs for Team & Personal Pages (Sub-sites only) | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Create Custom URLs for Team & Personal Pages (Sub-sites only)

If you've ever wanted to add that "Signature Touch" to your Team or Personal Fundraising Page, creating a**Custom URL** is a great way to start! Having a link that is memorable and easy for potential donors is a great way to promote your fundraiser.  
Please note that this feature is **not**enabled by default and it is only available on subsites (child sites).

You will need to reach out to your Partner Success Representative to have it enabled on your site.

This feature allows you to create a custom URL for your Team or Personal Page by setting your own suffix.

For example, if I set my suffix to 'jake', and my site is 'mysite.crowdchange.co', my custom URL will be:

*mysite.crowdchange.co/page/jake*

Please follow these steps to set your custom URL suffix:

1. Go to your Team or Personal Page and **Log In**.

2. Click **Manage my Team (or Manage my Personal Page)** in the upper right-hand corner of the page.

3. Go to **Team (or Page) Settings**on the left sidebar.

4. Enter a custom URL suffix under **Name Your Team Page / Personal Page Link** (Example below).

   ![image-20231026-161421.png](../assets/how-to-create-custom-urls-for-team-personal-pages-/image-20231026-161421.png)  
   ![image-20231026-161331.png](../assets/how-to-create-custom-urls-for-team-personal-pages-/image-20231026-161331.png)

Once successfully saved, you will be ready to share this link with friends and family, or on social media!

Eg: *mysite.crowdchange.co/page/jake*  
Custom Team \& Personal Page URL's will be visible in the following **Admin**Reports:

* Personal Pages Report

* Registration Report

* Teams Report

**This feature is only available on the site where the fundraiser was created. (Sub-sites only)**

For example:

If a fundraiser is created on a sub/child site, the URLs can only be set, and will only work on that site.

They will not work and cannot be changed on the parent site.

# How to Access the Donations Report (Fundraiser Level)

The **Donations Report** offers a quick and easy way to find information on all donations made to your fundraiser. You can also use it to [**resend receipts**](how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email.md) and [**move donations**](how-to-move-donations-to-another-team-or-personal-.md) between personal or team pages.

To access it, follow the simple steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and**Log In**.

2. Go to your fundraising page and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiserz.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-donations-report-fundraiser-leve/managefundraiserz.png)
3. On the left sidebar, click **Reports** , then **Fundraiser Report**.

   ![image-20250723-155813.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-donations-report-fundraiser-leve/image-20250723-155813.png)
4. You will be shown an **Overview**with the following information:

   ![image-20240821-134930.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-donations-report-fundraiser-leve/image-20240821-134930.png)
5. Depending on which Purchase options you have enabled, you will also be shown 'Overview' sections with some basic details like sales of tickets, apparel, registration, etc, as well as information on teams and personal pages within your fundraiser. You can download any of these overview sections to Excel by clicking their respective **Download**button.

   ![image-20240821-135109.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-donations-report-fundraiser-leve/image-20240821-135109.png)
6. If you need to see specific transactions and transaction details, scroll down to the **Detailed Report** section. Here you can search for specific transactions by Name, Email, and Transaction ID, and you can see the details of each transaction, including the amount, display name used, answers to custom questions, and more. You can see which team and/or personal page the donation was made to and change this via the **Change team or page**button.

   ![image-20240821-135229.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-donations-report-fundraiser-leve/image-20240821-135229.png)
7. You can download the Excel version of this report via the **Download**button in the top right corner.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-move-donations-to-another-team-or-personal- | Nav: How to Access the Donations Report (Fundraiser Level) > How to Move Donations to another Team or Personal Page | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Move Donations to another Team or Personal Page

As a fundraiser host or Admin user, moving donations from one Team or Personal Page to another, within a single fundraiser, is easily done via the fundraiser-level**Donations Report**.

To do this yourself, simply follow the steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Go to your fundraiser (main fundraising page) and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. On the left sidebar, click**Reports** , then **Donations Report**.

4. Click on the transaction you would like to move to a different Team or Personal Page.

5. Click the **Change Team or page** button as highlighted below.

   ![changeteam.png](../assets/how-to-move-donations-to-another-team-or-personal-/changeteam.png)
6. Enter the Team and/or Personal Page you'd like to move this donation to and click **Save**.

   ![save3.png](../assets/how-to-move-donations-to-another-team-or-personal-/save3.png)

If Donation Matching is enabled, when a donation is moved between Teams or Personal Pages, its matched amount is automatically recalculated using the destination Team/Personal Page matching settings, and sponsor allocations are transferred accordingly so the source context is released and the destination context is correctly funded.

# How to Re-send a Receipt / Confirmation Email

As a fundraiser host or Admin user, you have the ability to re-send receipts. This is useful in cases where a donor/registrant/sponsor/purchaser did not receive their email confirmation. This is easily done via your fundraiser-level**Donations Report**.

To re-send a receipt / confirmation email, simply follow the steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Go to the fundraiser the transaction was made to and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. Click **Reports** on the left sidebar and go to **Donations Report**.

   ![donationsreports.png](../assets/how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email/donationsreports.png)
4. Scroll down to Detailed Report and search the **Transaction ID** ,**Name or Email Address**of the donor.

5. Click on the transaction and select **Resend Receipt**. See example below.

   ![resend.png](../assets/how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email/resend.png)
6. Select **To** **original recipient** to re-send to the same email address, or **To** **specific Email** to send to an updated email address. If you select 'To specific Email', you will be prompted to enter the new email.

   ![image-20240821-140701.png](../assets/how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email/image-20240821-140701.png)
7. Click **Send**to confirm.

# How to Access the Tickets Report (Fundraiser Level)

The **Tickets Report**is where you can find details of all tickets issued for your fundraiser. You can search/filter for specific tickets, and download either an Excel report of all tickets issued, or individual PDF tickets.

To access it, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Go to your fundraising page and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![manageup.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/manageup.png)
3. Click **Reports** on the left sidebar, then**Tickets Report**.

   ![ticketsreport.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/ticketsreport.png)
4. You will be taken to the **Tickets Report** **→ Ticket Details**page, where you can see detailed information on all issued tickets. If you're looking for information on a specific ticket, you can use the search bar and search by name, ticket number or email. You may also filter by the Status and Tier of the ticket.

   ![image-20240821-142452.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/image-20240821-142452.png)

You can download an Excel report listing all tickets issued by clicking **Download**. The email you receive with the download link will have the subject 'Fundraiser Guests Report'.

The Excel report also contains answers to custom checkout and registration questions.

To download PDFs of **individual tickets**, click the download icon to the right of each ticket.

# How to Access the Registrations Report (Fundraiser Level) - Multi-registration fundraisers only

As the host of a multi-registration enabled fundraiser, your **Registrations Report**is where you can find details about all registrants and registration transactions. You can search/filter by email address, transaction ID or page name, and download an Excel report of all registrations.

To access it, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Go to your multi-registration enabled fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. On the left sidebar, click**Reports** and then **Registrations Report**.

   ![image-20250729-140114.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registrations-report-fundraiser-/image-20250729-140114.png)

4. You will be taken to the **Registration Report** page, where you can see detailed information on all registration transactions. If you're looking for information on a specific registrant, you can use the search bar and search by email address, transaction ID or page name.

   ![image-20250729-140426.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registrations-report-fundraiser-/image-20250729-140426.png)

You can download a more detailed CSV version of this report by clicking **Download**in the top right.

The email you receive with download link will have the subject 'Registration Report'.

It will also contain the answers to custom checkout and registration questions.

# How to Use the Access Manager - Give others Admin Access for an Event (Fundraiser Level)

You can use your fundraiser's **Access Manager** to set administrative permissions for new or existing users. This is especially useful when you need to give **Edit** or **Reports Access** to a new user who does not have an existing CrowdChange account.

Once the desired permissions have been set, an invitation email will be sent to the new user, who will be prompted to create an account and accept the permissions.

To utilize this feature, click **ManageMy Fundraiser** , then**Access Manager** on the left sidebar.  
![image-20250723-181039.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250723-181039.png)  
![image-20250723-181216.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250723-181216.png)

On the Access Manager page, you can **give** , **edit** and **remove**custom access.

When users are given access, they will be listed and edit / remove controls will be shown.  
Please note that users you give access to using Access Manager will **not** receive **Fundraiser Notification Emails**. Currently, these are only sent to the Fundraiser Owner, and site-wide Admins.

## To Give Access

1. Click **Add Account**.

2. Enter the new or existing user's email and click **Continue**.

   1. If the user already exists in our system, you will see the name of the user.

   2. If the user does not yet exist, you will need to enter their first and last name.

3. Click the checkbox or toggle next to all permissions you desire the user to have, or click **Full Access**.

   ![image-20250723-181618.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250723-181618.png)

4. Click **Send Invite**in the bottom-right corner when ready.

### To Edit Access

1. Click the cog / gear icon next to the user you want to edit.

2. Click **Edit**.

   ![editaccess.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/editaccess.png)
3. Change permissions as desired and click **Save**.

### To Remove Access

1. Click the cog / gear icon next to the user you want to remove.

2. Click **Remove Access**.

   ![remove22.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/remove22.png)
3. Click **Remove access**

   ![image-20250805-170707.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250805-170707.png)

If your invitation is pending, you will instead see the option to **resend** , or **cancel**it.

# How to Use the Site-Level Access Manager

You can use the **Site-Level** **Access Manager** to set custom administrative permissions for new or existing users across your CrowdChange site.  
**Prerequisites:**

To be able to access **Admin → Access Manager** the following conditions must be met:

1. **Access Manager** feature must be enabled on your CrowdChange site.

2. You must have **User Manager** permissions.

Once these conditions are met, follow the simple steps below to get started:

1. From anywhere on your CrowdChange site, go to **Profile → Admin**.

   ![profileadmin.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-site-level-access-manager/profileadmin.png)
2. Click the **Access Manager** tab on the left sidebar.

   ![ACCESSMGR2.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-site-level-access-manager/ACCESSMGR2.png)

   You will be taken to the site-level Access Manager where you will be shown a list of any added users and their assigned roles. The default roles available to be assigned are **Admin** , **Banking** and **User Manager**. You may also add custom roles with specific sets of permissions (for example: Reports-Only access). Roles can be assigned to existing users or new users via email invitation.  
   ![image-20231028-151850.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-site-level-access-manager/image-20231028-151850.png)
3. *Optional: To create new custom role, click* ***Manage Roles*** *, then* ***Add Role*** *. Check all the permissions you would like to give this user and click* ***Save*** *to confirm. See an example below of 'Reports-Only' access.*

   ![customrole.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-site-level-access-manager/customrole.png)
4. From the main page of the Site-level Access Manager (see Step 2), click **Assign User** to assign existing role(s) to a new or existing user. You can also assign roles per-organization if this feature is utilized.

   1. *If the user does not already have a CrowdChange account, they will be sent an email invitation to create one and accept the permissions.*

5. You can **update** or **remove**existing permissions from the user list using the pencil and 'x' buttons:

   ![image-20231028-154344.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-site-level-access-manager/image-20231028-154344.png)

description: 'Overview There are 3 types of Email Templates which can be set up and used: Automated (preset) email templates - These include donor receipts, and certain auto…'
last_modified: '2024-10-03T19:04:48.940Z'
retrieved: '2026-10-14'

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-email-templates-work | Nav: How Email Templates Work | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How Email Templates Work

## Overview

There are 3 types of Email Templates which can be set up and used:

1. Automated (preset) email templates - These include donor receipts, and certain automated actions like "Fundraiser reached the goal".

2. Custom templates for Mailing List emails.

3. Custom templates for Milestone Notifications.

These emails can be setup in 2 ways:

1. From your Admin Dashboard - **Profile → Admin → Communication Settings** - These templates will be applied to all fundraisers on your CrowdChange site.

2. From a specific fundraiser - **Manage Fundraiser → Automated email templates** / **Milestones** - These templates will be applied only to the fundraiser in question. Mailing List templates are at **Manage Fundraiser → Mailing List → Templates**.

### Email Template Hierarchy

When an email is sent, the template is determined in the following way:

* If the Fundraiser-specific email template has been updated, it will be applied to the associated action.

* **Otherwise**,

  * If a site-wide (Admin) email template has been updated - this will be used.

* **Otherwise**,

* The default CrowdChange template will be used.

For example, when a donor makes a donation to "**Fundraiser A** " on a site called "**My CrowdChange Site**":

1. We check if "**Fundraiser A** " has its own Donor Receipt email template. If yes, we send the email receipt using the "**Fundraiser A**" template.

2. If "**Fundraiser A** " does not have it's own template, we check if "**My CrowdChange Site** " site has a template set up through **Profile →** **Admin → Communication Settings**. If yes, we send the email using this template.

3. If neither "**Fundraiser A** ", nor "**My CrowdChange Site**" site have customized templates → we send the receipt with the default CrowdChange template.

## Automated Emails

Automated emails are the most basic email templates and are used by preset automated actions.

For example:

* When a user makes a donation → the 'Donor Receipt' template is sent out.

* When a fundraiser raises 100% of it's goal → the 'Fundraiser Goal Reached' template is sent out.

### Conditional Blocks in Automated Emails

Some automated emails support conditional blocks. This allows you to have specific text inserted in the email if for example, tickets are purchased, or a registration is completed.

Conditional blocks can be found within the dynamic tags list accessed via the link highlighted below:  
![tagsdynamic.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/tagsdynamic.png)
To view the list of tags, click 'See all available tags' or type `{name`  
![image-20231012-161221.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20231012-161221.png)

These blocks start with `{begin-...}` and end with `{end-...}` tags. The content between these tags will be added conditionally to the email text.

**For example:**

If 'Donor Receipt' email template includes `{begin-tickets}Your tickets are attached to this email{end-tickets}` in the content, this text will only be included in the email if the donor purchases at least one ticket.

#### Amount-Specific Conditional Blocks

If you would like to send specific text, or a bigger 'Thank You' depending on the **amount** that was donated, you can do so using the example syntax shown below:  
![image-20211122-011921.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20211122-011921.png)

#### Supported Templates

At the moment of writing, the following templates support conditional blocks:  

|         Template          |                      Block                      |                    Rendered on Condition                     |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Fundraiser Created**    | `{begin-pending}` ... `{end-pending}`           | If fundraiser is pending approval.                           |
| **Donor Receipt**         | `{begin-donation}` ... `{end-donation}`         | If donation amount was over $0.                              |
| *(Amount Specific Ex 1):* | `{begin-donation:10-49.99}`... `{end-donation}` | If donation made was between $10 and $49.99                  |
| *(Amount Specific Ex 2):* | `{begin-donation:50-100}` ...`{end-donation}`   | If donation made was between $50 and $100                    |
| *(Amount Specific Ex 3):* | `{begin-donation:50}` ... `{end-donation}`      | If donation made was exactly $50                             |
|                           | `{begin-tickets}` ... `{end-tickets}`           | If at least one ticket was purchased.                        |
|                           | `{begin-registration}` ... `{end-registration}` | If at least one registration was purchased.                  |
|                           | `{begin-apparel}` ... `{end-apparel}`           | If at least one apparel (or merchandize) item was purchased. |
|                           | `{begin-sponsorship}` ... `{end-sponsorship}`   | If at least one sponsorship package was purchased.           |

## Mailing List Emails

Mailing List email templates are used when sending out email communication to Imported Contacts, Donors and Team Fundraising Captains from the Mailing List of a specific Fundraiser.

After creating a Mailing List template at the Admin level, it will be available whenever a fundraiser owner goes to **Manage Fundraiser → Mailing List** and creates an email campaign.

Additionally, these templates can be used by Personal Page Owners when they go to their Personal Page level **Manage Fundraiser → Mailing List**and create an email / campaign.

### How to use Mailing List Templates

1. Create a new Mailing List template by going to **Profile → Admin → Communication Settings → Mailing List Templates** , scrolling down to the bottom (if there are already entries) and clicking the '**Create Template** ' button.

   ![create template.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/create_template.png)

   Once clicked, you will see the below fields appear. Ensure to click the '**Save** ' button when finished.

   ![image-20231012-161823.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20231012-161823.png)
2. Once you save the template, it will be available for fundraiser owners to use (via **Manage Fundraiser → Mailing List** ). From a fundraiser's mailing list, they can simply click '**New Campaign** ', and select the template they want to use via the '**Select email Template** ' dropdown. See screenshots below.

   ![templates.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/templates.png)  
   ![3f.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/3f.png)

   **Please Note:** Fundraiser owners can also save and delete their own templates. To do so, they can check the "**Save this message as a template** " checkbox when sending out an email campaign, and the next time they will be able to select it from the "**Select Email Template** " menu.

   ![image-20221008-203041.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20221008-203041.png)

## Milestone Notification Emails \& Badges

Milestone Notification Emails are sent when a Fundraiser, Team or Personal Page reaches certain goals.

For example, when a Fundraiser reaches 50% of it's goal or raises it's first $1,000.  
These emails are sent to the Fundraiser Owner and Personal / Team Page Owners, **NOT** to donors.

To customize and provide pre-built templates for these emails, follow the steps below:

1. Go to **Profile → Admin → Communication Settings → Milestones**.

2. Click **Create milestone**.

3. Name the milestone and **select a trigger** from the '**When**' dropdown (Eg: Page Created, End of an event, Certain amount raised, Certain number of donations reached, etc).

   * If '**Upcoming event** ' is selected, the event **start** date/time is used as the trigger point to send the email. If '**After event** ' is selected and the fundraiser has both a start and end date/time, the **end** date/time is used as the trigger. If an end date/time is not set, **start**date/time is used as the trigger.

4. Select the Group which this milestone applies to (Eg: the Fundraiser owner, a page owner, registrant etc)

5. Enter a specific value which should trigger the milestone.

See the example milestone below which will be sent to page owners when they reach $1000 raised.  
![image-20221008-204936.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20221008-204936.png)

You will also have the option of adding a **Badge**to the milestone email. See example screenshot below. This is an awesome way to reward fundraisers for their hard work and support of your cause! You can select from our pre-built badges, or upload your own custom badge image using the pencil icon.  
![image-20221008-205423.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20221008-205423.png)

Finally, ensure to fill out the **Message Body** section which sets what text will appear in the milestone notification email. See example below.  
![image-20231012-163910.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20231012-163910.png)

When you are finished creating your milestone email template, click the **Save**button.  
![image-20231012-163931.png](../assets/how-email-templates-work/image-20231012-163931.png)  
Now, when a Fundraiser Owner goes to **Manage Fundraiser → Milestones** , they will be able to click **Create Milestone**and create their own milestones. The templates set at the Admin level are only changeable by Admin users.

# How to Use the Mailing List

You can use our **Mailing List** feature to send out email fundraising campaigns, or just to send a personalized thank you to your donors!

It's a great way to keep supporters up to date and engaged with your fundraiser, team or personal page.

To get started, follow the simple steps below!

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top right corner, then **Mailing List** .

   (*On a personal page or team, go to* ***Manage my page/team → Mailing List*** *in the top right).*

   ![image-20250805-180643.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-180643.png)

   ![image-20250805-180737.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-180737.png)

2. You will then be taken to the Mailing List main page, where you have three options:

   *You may also return here at any time to view information and reports on sent emails.*

   ![image-20250805-181020.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181020.png)

   1. **Contacts**- From here you can add to and manage your contact list. You may add contacts manually or import them from a CSV file. Donors to your fundraiser/team/page will be added automatically. Team Captains on your fundraiser will be added automatically.

   2. **Templates**- From here you can create and manage your email templates. For detailed tutorials on using email templates, check out the following articles:

      1. **How to Create a Custom Email Template**

      2. **How to Edit a Pre-existing Email Template**

      3. **How Email Templates Work**

   3. **Send email** - This is where you will go to send out emails (campaigns).

3. To send out your first email campaign, click on **Send Email**.

   ![image-20250805-181227.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181227.png)

4. Click **Choose Recipients** within the **To**field and select all contacts you'd like to send to.

   ![image-20250805-181300.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181300.png)

5. Click the**Add Recipients** button in the bottom right.

   Note that you can use the dropdown in the top left corner to view these lists:**Imported Contacts** , **Donors** ,**Previous Donors** and **Team Captains**. The latter three are automatically stored as contacts.

   ![image-20250805-181400.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181400.png)

6. Add and verify your email address in the **From** field. *If you are adding yourself as sender for the first time, CrowdChange will send a verification code to your email to confirm your identity. When you receive the email verification code, copy \& paste the code into CrowdChange and click* ***Verify*** *. If you do not receive a verification email, click* ***resend verification code*** *.*

   ![image-20250805-182339.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-182339.png)

7. If you would like to use an email template you added previously, select it under **Select email template**.

   ![image-20250805-182412.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-182412.png)

8. Fill out your **Subject** and **Message** fields, using the **Dynamic Tags** feature to have certain information automatically pulled in when sending a campaign to multiple recipients. This allows you to send **one** email to **multiple** recipients, rather than sending many one-recipient emails, and having to enter data like this each time: *Recipient First Name \& Last Name, Fundraiser Raised Amount, Link to Fundraiser.* See further examples in screenshot below. For more info, see **How Email Templates Work**.

   ![dynamic tags.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/dynamic_tags.png)
9. Check the '**Save this message as a template for future use** ' field if desired, and complete the **reCAPTCHA**verification.

   ![eg34.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/eg34.png)
10. If you'd like, you can send yourself a preview email before sending out the email campaign. Simply click the '**Send preview email**' button to do so.

    ![sendpreview.png](/__attachments/a_888eba41cdc6f88a513a7c7025f22fa3468b23a3ca4c039e0c17eb1e738f3fb4/sendpreview.png?cb=aad80e1746281508d39ae010872781b9)
11. When you are ready, click on the **Send**button to send out your email campaign.

    ![saveeeeeeee.png](/__attachments/a_ca9d3c21194dd80e25f8d86ba467bba53bf246dc207d22dcdeff12eaea33c2e3/saveeeeeeee.png?cb=e37b190da3182f4aa68dde2e8bfbcd89)

# How to Create a Custom Email Template

You can save a lot of time sending email campaigns by creating **custom templates** within the Mailing List!  
See also: **How to Use the Mailing List**

Follow these simple steps below to create a custom email template:

1. From your fundraising page, click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiserzz.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/managefundraiserzz.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click**Mailing List**.

   ![mailingliss.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/mailingliss.png)
3. Click **Templates** , then **Create New Template**.

   ![templates1.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/templates1.png)

   ![createnewtemplate.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/createnewtemplate.png)
4. Set a **Template Name** , **Subject** , **Message Body** , and add any desired **Dynamic Tags**. For example:

   ![tagsz.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/tagsz.png)
5. *Optional: Click* ***Send Preview Email*** *to get a preview.*

6. Click **Save**to save the template.

# How to Edit a Pre-existing Email Template

To **edit** an email template you've already created, it's super easy!

This article covers how to edit your existing email templates within our **Mailing List** feature.  
See also: **How to Use the Mailing List**

To edit an existing email template, follow the steps below:

1. From your fundraising page, click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiserzz.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/managefundraiserzz.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click**Mailing List**.

   ![mailingliss.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/mailingliss.png)
3. Click **Templates**.

   ![templates1.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/templates1.png)
4. Click **Edit**to the right of the template you would like to adjust.

   ![thanksedit.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/thanksedit.png)
5. Edit **Template Name** , **Subject** , **Message Body** , and **Dynamic Tags** as desired.

6. *Optional: Click* ***Send Preview Email*** *to get a preview.*

7. Click **Save**to save the changes to this template.

# Mailing List - Contact & Recipient Limits

In order to prevent the proliferation of spam messages via the CrowdChange Mailing List, certain limits are in place around sending to and adding large numbers of contacts, as well as how many emails can be sent per hour.

Please see below the limits currently in place (defined by user role):

## Maximum number of recipients that can be added without approval when sending an email:

* Personal Page Owners: 100

* Team Page Owners: 100

* Fundraiser Owners: 500

* Site-wide Admin: No limit

### Maximum number of contacts a user's address book / contact list can hold at any given time:

* Personal Page Owners: 1000

* Team Page Owners: 1000

* Fundraiser Owners: 5,000

* Site-wide Admin: No limit

*\^ These specific limits do not apply to the following contact lists: Donors, Previous Donors, Team Captains.*

#### Limits regarding how often users can send emails via the Mailing List:

* Personal page owners, Team page owners and Fundraiser owners are limited to a specific number of contacts per hour, listed below:

  * Personal Page Owners: 500

  * Team Page Owners: 500

  * Fundraiser Owners: 5,000

  * Site-wide Admin: No limit

* Once you reach the hourly limit, you cannot send another email until a new hour begins.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/mailing-list-admin-approval-for-large-campaigns | Nav: Mailing List - Admin Approval for large campaigns | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Mailing List - Admin Approval for large campaigns

If a personal or team page owner attempts to send a Mailing List campaign to over 100 recipients simultaneously, this campaign will be flagged for Admin review and approval before it can be sent out.  
**Please Note:**If the user's attempted message is approved, they are marked as approved in our system and will not be flagged again when sending a message to more than 100 recipients.

Additional limits in place which would trigger the approval process are indicated in [**this article**](mailing-list-contact-recipient-limits.md).

An email notification will be sent to site Adminswith two options - **Approve** or **Reject**, so they can act on the email immediately without needing to go to the site. Here is what the email will look like:  
![approvalemail1.png](../assets/mailing-list-admin-approval-for-large-campaigns/approvalemail1.png)
The email subject line and message body will appear in this section.  
![approvereject.png](../assets/mailing-list-admin-approval-for-large-campaigns/approvereject.png)

If desired, they can also go to **Admin \> Reports \> Mailing List Approval** and approve or reject from there.

Once on the Mailing List Approval page, two tabs are available: **Pending Approval** \& **History**.

**Pending Approval**shows a table with all pending campaigns listed, and by checking the checkbox next to a campaign or multiple campaigns you can access the options to Approve or Reject.  
![approvalpage1.png](../assets/mailing-list-admin-approval-for-large-campaigns/approvalpage1.png)

**History**shows a table with all previously approved or rejected campaigns listed.  
![mailinglistapproval.png](../assets/mailing-list-admin-approval-for-large-campaigns/mailinglistapproval.png)

Clicking on a campaign's name (under Subject) will take you directly to the campaign report.

The status of a pending email campaign will be shown as '**Queued**' (to both the sender and the Admins) until Admin approval has been granted and it is sent out.

# Fundraiser Approval (Admins)

CrowdChange is strictly an online fundraising platform, and therefore we cannot approve or reject fundraisers. It is the responsibility of the relevant Charity or Organization to do so.

If you are an Admin on the site of your Charity or Organization, please follow the steps below:

1. Go to the home page of your CrowdChange site. (Browse Fundraisers page).

2. Below the 'Start A Fundraiser' button, click **Show All** on the right-hand side, then **Pending Approval**.

3. Click on the fundraiser which is pending approval.

4. Click**Manage Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

5. *Optional: You are able to view and update fundraiser settings before approval if necessary\*.*

6. When everything looks good, click the green **Approve** button in the top right corner.

   *If necessary, you can reject the fundraiser using the 'Reject' button adjacent. This will essentially delete it.*

   ![approve.png](../assets/fundraiser-approval-admins/approve.png)

**Please note:** Once a fundraiser has been approved, it can then accept donations.

If a fundraiser has been mistakenly approved, please click here for steps to close a fundraiser: [**How to Reopen or Close a Fundraiser**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Reopen-or-Close-a-Fundraiser.1993867341.html)  
**\*** In some cases, fundraisers can only be edited from the site where they were created.

For example, if you have a child site (sub-site), and that child site has "Fundraiser Custom Questions" enabled and setup, when you create a fundraiser on the child site and try to edit it from the parent site (pre or post approval), you will get a prompt re-directing you to the child site to make your edits.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-enter-offline-donations | Nav: How to Enter Offline Donations | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Enter Offline Donations

You can use our **Offline Donations** feature to:

* Add donations you've received outside of CrowdChange to your Total Amount Raised and Donor List

* Pay a donation on behalf of a donor, with them receiving a Tax Receipt in their name

* Facilitate [**Pledging**](how-pledging-works.md)and send donors a direct Payment link via Email or SMS

To add in an Offline Donation, follow these steps:

1. Go to the fundraising page (or Personal / Team Page) you would like to add the donation to.

2. Click **Manage Fundraiser** (on fundraisers) then go to **Offline donations** on the left sidebar.

   ![image-20250715-185746.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250715-185746.png)  
   ![image-20250715-182725.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250715-182725.png)

3. On Personal / Team pages, click**Manage my page (or team)→ Offline donations**.

   ![image-20250715-191146.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250715-191146.png)

4. Click **Add Donation** and fill out the required fields. **Please note**the following:

   1. *If desired, you can email a payment link by entering an email and clicking the '* ***Send link for individual or group to make online payment*** *'* *checkbox. If you would like to send a payment link via SMS instead of email, leave this checkbox* ***unchecked*** *- once the donation has been added, you will be able to click* ***Share Payment Link*** *and send to your desired phone number.*

   2. *If you select '* ***This is a Lump Sum Donation*** *', you will* ***not*** *be required to enter any Billing Information, and* ***no*** *Tax Receipt will be issued.*

      ![image-20230714-134010.png](/__attachments/a_f479205b6e062f29e4a82fc6f59f416478bb595f7cbda984a978a409d7f91a74/image-20230714-134010.png?cb=5df54268ecd999e074fdb6e42c7305b7)
   3. *If you require a tax receipt for this donation, click '* ***Request tax receipt for this donation*** *' and enter the billing address of the donor for tax receipt.*

   4. *To assign this donation to a team, indicate the payment method and date of donation, set a donation display name, write a public comment, show/hide the donation amount, and/or add any internal notes about this donation, click '* ***Show advanced settings*** *' under '* ***Additional Information*** *'.*

   5. *If you select* ***Mark as Received*** *under '* ***Transaction Status*** *', the donation will be confirmed and shown in CrowdChange Donations Reports. This will be done automatically if online payment is received.*

      ![image-20250715-203324.png](/__attachments/a_0be9f39b52febb33836a982b3f029fdca17652d10603c39c29638f09bc2449f2/image-20250715-203324.png?cb=5df160ade420eccad57a8fc0eca60b37)

5. Once you have added the information as desired, click **Save**at the bottom of the page.

   ![image-20250716-143925.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250716-143925.png)

6. You can return to the Offline Donations menu at any time to **view** , **update** or **delete** donations entered.

   ![image-20250716-174904.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250716-174904.png)

Offline Donations will only be shown in our Donations Reports once they have been **paid/received**.

However, Offline Donations **will be** included in Total Raised bar amounts while in **Pending**.

Only admins and the host of a fundraiser have the option to **Mark As Received**.

If desired, you can send donors a **Payment Link** for them to pay a pending donation themselves. Just click the triple dot icon next to the donation you'd like them to pay and select **Share Payment Link.**

## To make a donation on behalf of someone else

1. Go to**Manage Fundraiser → Offline Donations** (Personal / Team pages:**Manage my page (or team) → Offline donations**).

2. Click **Add Donation** and enter the donor's details. Enter **Tax Receipt Information** if necessary.

3. Under**Additional Information → Show Advanced Settings** , select **Credit Card** as Payment Method.

4. Once you have added all relevant information, click **Save**at the bottom of the page.

5. Click **Pay Now** next to the pending donation to pay for the donation using your own Credit Card \& Billing info. The tax receipt will still be issued in the donor's name and address (entered in Step 2).

## To issue a tax receipt after an offline donation has been entered

1. Go to**Manage Fundraiser → Offline Donations** (Personal / Team pages:**Manage my page (or team)→ Offline donations**).

2. Find the donation you would like to issue a Tax Receipt for and click the **triple dot icon** next to it.

3. Click **Issue Tax Receipt**.

4. Fill out all necessary information and click **Issue**.

This will only be an option for donations that have been **Paid** or **Marked as Received**.

If you want to re-issue a tax receipt for an offline donation, follow the same steps, but you will select **Re-Issue Tax Receipt** instead.

# How to Access the Activity Log

The **Activity Log**gives you a list of all recent administrative actions taken by users on your site.

To access it, follow these simple steps:

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

   ![activity log.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-activity-log/activity_log.png)

# How to Access the Fundraisers Report

The **Fundraisers Report**provides you with detailed information on all fundraisers that have been created, as well as links to each one, and the option to download an Excel spreadsheet of all fundraisers.  
Please note that the default date range filter is set to **one month**.

You will need to change this to see fundraisers created more than one month ago.

To access this report, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Fundraisers Report**using the left sidebar.

   ![fundraisers report.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-fundraisers-report/fundraisers_report.png)
4. To find a specific fundraiser, you can use the search bar and/or click **Filters** in the top right corner to filter for a specific Time Period, Organization, Subsite, or Fundraiser. Be sure to click **Show results** to apply these filters.

   ![show results.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-fundraisers-report/show_results.png)
5. Download the Excel version of this report by clicking **Download**!

   ![download2.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-fundraisers-report/download2.png)

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-access-the-payouts-report | Nav: How to Access the Payouts Report | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Access the Payouts Report

The **Payouts Report**shows you the details of all money paid out to your connected bank account as well as transaction specific amounts. Ensure to select the correct date range and use the Excel version of the report for best results.  
This report is only available for partners using Stripe as their payment gateway.

To access this report, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Payout Report**using the left sidebar.

   ![payouts report.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-payouts-report/payouts_report.png)
4. Select your desired date range under 'Payouts Between' and click**Apply Filters** (You also can filter for a specific account using the dropdown menu under 'Accounts').

5. Click **Download** to get the Excel version sent to your email (highly recommended).

6. If viewing the web version,**click** the account row you would like to view payout details for.

   ![payout1.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-payouts-report/payout1.png)
7. Then**click**on a payout row to view its summary and individual transaction details.

   ![payout2.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-payouts-report/payout2.png)

Please note that within the Excel Payout Report, refunds and chargebacks are currently shown as positive numbers rather than negative, which may result in an apparent discrepancy between the Summary and Detailed tabs of the report.

To clarify, the**Global Account Summary**tab will reflect the actual/true payout amounts.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-access-the-admin-donations-report | Nav: How to Access the Admin Donations Report | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Access the Admin Donations Report

The **Admin** **Donations Report**allows you to:

* View detailed information for all transactions across your CrowdChange site.

* Edit public-facing donation information (Displayed name, comment, and whether amount is shown).

* Edit donor's answers to custom checkout questions (on their request).

* Issue, re-issue, re-send, and download Tax Receipts.

* Refund transactions (fully or partially).

Please note that the report's default date range filter is set to **one month**.

Transactions are sorted by `fundraiser + id` in descending order. If you need to view all transactions by date for all fundraisers - you would need to manually sort them after opening the CSV file in Excel.

Larger datasets (10,000+ records) may take longer to generate. If you have not received exported data from your CrowdChange site after a few hours, please contact customer support.

To access this report, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Donations Report**using the left sidebar.

   ![donationsreport3.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-admin-donations-report/donationsreport3.png)
4. To find a specific transaction, you can use the search bar to search by email, name, or transaction ID.

5. Click **Filters** in the top right corner to filter for a specific Time Period, Organization, Subsite, or Fundraiser. If you are using a site with Blueprints enabled, you will be able to filter by Blueprint as well. Be sure to click **Show results** to apply these filters.

   ![show results.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-admin-donations-report/show_results.png)
6. Clicking on a specific transaction will take you to the **transaction page** where you can see it's full details including purchase options, answers to custom questions, covered fees and more. From here you can:

   1. **Issue, Download, Re-send, or Re-issue Tax Receipts** within the **Tax Receipt** section.

      ![image-20230911-150212.png](/__attachments/a_fbd38ad15b836747c9f14be625a4c1cbac8b5fda1139ad98bfd2a9bcdb584d77/image-20230911-150212.png?cb=8077f53e4f5d680438cbda86a37c6bbf)
   2. [**Edit Display Name, Comment and Show or Hide Amount on a Donation**](how-to-edit-display-name-comment-and-show-or-hide-.md) by clicking **Edit** within the **Additional Information**section.

      ![image-20230911-150306.png](/__attachments/a_3ae67678514ba5bd1441e510ef023c514e2619cc0cb6b99900481482fe092ee4/image-20230911-150306.png?cb=a17eb133acb5ec0145bd46bb26d7e810)
   3. **View** and **Edit** answers to custom questions within the **Custom Questions** section.

      ![image-20230911-150356.png](/__attachments/a_30266385dcdbf3337fad58042fe89fb3ee46801df1c20e8a4758c8ec877147fb/image-20230911-150356.png?cb=8bb19f7d09ccbf40acf7a7eb750bd495)
   4. [**Issue a Full or Partial Refund**](how-to-issue-full-and-partial-refunds.md) by clicking **Refund** in the bottom right.

      ![move3.png](/__attachments/a_7e62e9c4fe6cc937df758d411d5478bfe77cadeb7edc5f9adaf9d3b5a66cb98f/move3.png?cb=7b23f0959525cfddccec2a39f84c5cb5)
7. Download the Excel CSV versions of this report by clicking **Download** and selecting either:

   1. **Summary Only** - Downloads a ZIP archive containing the Summary CSV file only.

   2. **Summary and transactions** - Downloads a ZIP archive containing the Summary, (all) Transactions and (all) Registrations CSV files.

   3. **Full detailed report** - Downloads a ZIP archive containing the Summary, (all) Transactions, (all) Registrations, and Failed transactions CSV files, as well as individual CSV files for each fundraiser's transactions which are named as follows: `f - {fundraiser ID}`.

      ![fulldetailedreport.png](/__attachments/a_f844750326d32f092579ca33fbcf3d9ed990d9688e2b97f0a345b83c80528df7/fulldetailedreport.png?cb=77ec3fcea0c0fb736d3f18a3860c4600)

**IMPORTANT:** If you are looking for the answers to**Custom Checkout Questions** in the Excel CSV reports, download the 'Full Detailed Report' and open your fundraiser's specific CSV file (Eg: f-7246).

The fundraiser ID is the number at the end of your main fundraising page's URL.

Once in the Excel CSV file, you must scroll horizontally all the way to the right. The answers to custom checkout questions will be in the last few columns.  
Re-issuing a tax receipt will **VOID** the initial receipt. This will be displayed within the Admin Tax Receipts report and a **VOID**stamp will be added to the PDF copy of the original receipt.

The donor will receive notification of this and the re-issued receipt will communicate that it is a replacement for the original receipt.

# How to Edit Display Name, Comment and Show or Hide Amount on a Donation

One of the most useful features of the Admin Donations Report is the capability it offers Admin users to change display names, comments and amount show/hide settings of donations.

To do this yourself, simply follow the steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-move-general-donations-to-registrant-person | Nav: How to Access the Admin Donations Report > How to Move General Donations to Registrant Personal Pages - Multi-Registration sites only | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Move General Donations to Registrant Personal Pages - Multi-Registration sites only

On multi-registration enabled sites, in cases where a registrant makes a **general**donation instead of a donation to a personal fundraising page created in the same transaction, as an Admin user, you have the ability to move this donation to the personal fundraising page via the Admin Donations Report.

Follow the simple steps below to do so:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site, and **Log In**.

2. Click**Profile → Admin**in the top right corner.

3. Click**Reports → Donations Report**on the left sidebar.

4. Click the relevant registration transaction and you will be taken to the transaction page.

5. Scroll down and click **Move Donation**at the bottom of the page.

   ![movedonation.png](../assets/how-to-move-general-donations-to-registrant-person/movedonation.png)
6. In the pop-up that appears, complete the **From** , **To** and **Amount**fields as desired.

   ![movedon.png](../assets/how-to-move-general-donations-to-registrant-person/movedon.png)
7. Click **Submit**to confirm and move the donation.

The donation will now be shown on the registrant's personal fundraising page as desired.

This process can also be performed in reverse to move a personal page donation to a general one.
