<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/beta-moving-a-transaction-to-a-different-fundraise | Nav: How to Access the Admin Donations Report > Beta - Moving a Transaction to a Different Fundraiser | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Beta - Moving a Transaction to a Different Fundraiser

We have recently released a new feature in Beta, that allows certain types of transactions to be moved from one fundraiser to another within the same CrowdChange site.  
**Please Note:** This feature is **NOT**available by default and must be enabled by CrowdChange staff.

Once enabled, moving these transactions can be done from the[**Admin Donations Report**](how-to-access-the-admin-donations-report.md).

Simply select a transaction and click '**Move Transaction**' at the bottom of the transaction panel:  
![movetransactionn.png](../assets/beta-moving-a-transaction-to-a-different-fundraise/movetransactionn.png)

You will be prompted to select the fundraiser you'd like to move the transaction to, and (if applicable), the purchase options in the new fundraiser you'd like to map current purchase options to.

*** ** * ** ***

**When moving a transaction, the following data will be moved:**

* The transaction information, purchase options \& answers to custom registration questions.

* Any related team information (if a team is being moved, custom questions for the team).

* Any related personal page information (if attached pages are moved, custom questions for the pages).

* Any donations moving with pages (including custom reg. question answers, purchase options, etc).

**Transactions can only be moved to another fundraiser if these conditions are met:**

* Fundraisers must be within the same CrowdChange site.

* Fundraisers must be connected to the same bank account.

* Fundraisers must allow for transfer (see more details below), for example:

  * You cannot move a transaction with tickets to a fundraiser without tickets.

  * You cannot move a transaction attached to a personal page to a fundraiser that has no personal pages.

**Transactions can NOT be moved if the fundraiser / transaction has:**

* Activity tracker

* eCards / Tribute cards

* Donation matching applied

* Promo codes applied

* If there would be any changes to the total price (e.g. If tickets don't match in pricing, etc)

**NOTE:**The inclusion of the above features will be addressed in further iterations of Moving Transactions.

**Additional Notes:**

* If a transaction is attached to a registration which is attached to a personal page:

  * The personal page will be moved to the new fundraiser, along with all its attached transactions.

  * You are able to select a new team or no team from the new fundraiser.

* If the transaction was made to a personal page or a team:

  * You are able to select a new team or page from the new fundraiser.

* If tickets / apparel / registration / sponsorship are involved:

  * Transaction must be manually mapped to purchase options in the new fundraiser.

    * Coming soon - If both fundraisers were created from a Master Template, this will be automatic.

    * Admin must select new ticket / apparel / registration / sponsorship that matches the price of the existing purchase option (e.g. A $10 ticket cannot be mapped to a $5 ticket, a free ticket cannot be mapped to a $1 ticket, etc).

  * Limits will be checked (to ensure the purchase option is not sold out and would go over the limit).

  * Ticket / apparel / registration / sponsorship counts will be properly updated in both fundraisers.

* If custom questions are involved:

  * Custom questions must be manually remapped.

    * Coming soon - If both fundraisers were created from a Master Template, this will be automatic.

      * For now, all current responses are archived (Question + response from current transaction is shown) and the user is forced to provide responses to any new questions. The user must copy/paste, or enter that data themselves.

    * If custom questions cannot be mapped (e.g. Fundraiser A had 5 questions and Fundraiser B has 2 questions):

      * Existing answers are archived, not deleted, so that they can be accessed in future updates.

      * A warning is shown before trying to move the transaction, saying that custom questions will not be moved, and will be archived instead, and the user will need to provide new answers manually.

      * The user must fill in the new custom questions.

* Amounts are updated for all affected fundraisers, teams \& pages.

# How to Access the Admin Summary Report

The **Admin** **Summary Report**is a high-level breakdown of all transactions and transaction types across your fundraisers, including a count of Personal \& Team Pages created.

To access it, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Summary Report**using the left sidebar. Once there you will see the following sections:

   ![summary report.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-admin-summary-report/summary_report.png)  
   ![sections2.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-admin-summary-report/sections2.png)

You can filter for a specific date range, organization, subsite and/or fundraiser using the **Filters** button. To set the date range, click **Filters** and then the dates under **Time Period**.

Be sure to apply the filters by clicking the **Show results**button at the bottom.

Download the Excel version of this report by clicking **Download**button.

# How to Access the Registration Report

The **Registration Report**provides detailed information about all registrations made / purchased on your CrowdChange site. For sites with our Multi-Registration flow enabled, it provides useful functionality such as the ability to adjust individual registrant names, display names, comments, show/hide amount settings, and answers to custom checkout questions.

At a glance, you can see **Registrant Name** \& **Email Address** , the **Transaction ID** , **Date of Transaction** , selected **Registration Type** , associated **Personal / Team Page** (if any) and you will have links to those pages, as well as the fundraiser. The Excel version of the report provides further detail.  
You also have the ability to search for specific registrations (by email, name, or transaction ID), and filter the report for a specific time period, fundraiser, subsite and/or organization.

To access this report, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Registrations Report**using the left sidebar. You will be taken here:

   ![regreport2.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registration-report/regreport2.png)
4. To find a specific registration, you can use the search bar to search by email, name, or transaction ID. Click **Filters** in the top right corner to filter for a specific Time Period, Organization, Subsite, Fundraiser, and/or Master Template (if enabled on your site). Be sure to click **Show results** to apply these filters.

   ![showresults2.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registration-report/showresults2.png)
5. Click the **Download** button in the top right to get the Excel version of the report sent to your email!

   ![downloadbtn.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registration-report/downloadbtn.png)

Note that answers to [**Custom Questions**](how-to-use-custom-questions.md) which are set to '**Repeat for each registrant**' will appear in the Excel version of the Registration Report. Within this report, go to your fundraiser's specific tab (named: Fundraiser ID - Fundraiser Name), and scroll all the way to the right, to the last columns.

## To Change Registrant Name, Comment and Answers to Custom Questions

These features only apply for transactions made to fundraisers with our multi-registration flow.

Next to any registration on a multi-registration enabled site, you can click the **Change** button to adjust the registrant **name** ('username' in Admin Reports), and/or the**display name** (within public Donation Lists). You can also edit any displayed **comment** and set whether to show or hide the transaction **amount**.

Follow these simple steps to do so:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Registrations Report**using the left sidebar.

4. Click the **Change**button next to a registration.

   ![299307.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registration-report/299307.png)
5. Make any desired adjustments to registrant **name** (username in Admin Reports),**display name** , **comment** , **show/hide amount** setting, and **answers to custom checkout questions**.

   ![edit1.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registration-report/edit1.png)  
   ![edit2.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registration-report/edit2.png)
6. Click **Save**to confirm your changes.

================================================================================

# How to Edit Name and Display Name of a Registrant (Multi-Registration sites only)

Admin Users on sites with our Multi-Registration feature enabled have the ability to change the name and display name (on the Donation List) of a registrant via the **Admin Registration Report**.  
**Please Note** that changing the name (not display name) does not change the primary name attached to the registration itself (in the Registration Report under 'Registrant' column) - it only changes the user name field within the Excel version of the Report, and the name shown under 'Transaction Contents \> Self Donation' within a transaction on the web version of the Admin Donations Report.

To make the change, feel free to follow the simple steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Registration Report**using the left sidebar.

4. **Search** and/or **Filter** for the specific registration.

5. Click the **Change**button within a registration to edit the registrant details.

   ![change1.png](../assets/how-to-edit-name-and-display-name-of-a-registrant-/change1.png)
6. Enter the new or corrected name and display name, then click **Save**.

![save23.png](../assets/how-to-edit-name-and-display-name-of-a-registrant-/save23.png)

# How to Access the Personal Pages Report

The **Personal Pages Report**shows you information on all personal fundraising pages that have been created, including who the page owner is! (See crown icon next to user's name under Created By)

This report also allows you to see deleted personal pages and restore them if necessary.

To access it, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Personal Pages Report**using the left sidebar and you will be taken here:

   ![image-20250723-172951.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-personal-pages-report/image-20250723-172951.png)
4. You may use the search bar and/or click **Filters** in the top right corner to filter the pages listed by a specific Time Period, Organization, Subsite, Blueprints (if enabled), or Fundraiser. Be sure to click **Show results** to apply these filters.

   ![image-20250723-173109.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-personal-pages-report/image-20250723-173109.png)
5. Download the Excel version of this report by clicking **Download** in the top right!

   ![personalpagesdownload.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-personal-pages-report/personalpagesdownload.png)

## Restoring a Deleted Personal Page

To restore a personal page which was deleted, simply click the 'triple dot' icon to the right of the page marked as 'Deleted' (see tag in red), and click '**Restore**' as shown in screenshot below.  
![deletedpage.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-personal-pages-report/deletedpage.png)

Then click '**Yes**' within the prompt that appears:  
![yes2.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-personal-pages-report/yes2.png)

The page owner will receive an email notification letting them know that their page has been restored.

# How to Access the Teams Report

The **Teams Report**shows you information on all team fundraising pages that have been created, including who the team captain is! (See the crown icon next to user's name under Team Name)

This report also allows you to see deleted team pages and restore them if necessary.

To access it, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Teams Report**using the left sidebar, and you will be taken here:

   ![image-20250730-171937.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-teams-report/image-20250730-171937.png)

4. You may use the search bar and/or click **Filters** in the top right corner to filter the teams listed by a specific Time Period, Organization, Subsite, Master Template (if enabled), or Fundraiser. Be sure to click **Show results** to apply these filters.

   ![image-20250730-172221.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-teams-report/image-20250730-172221.png)

5. Download the Excel version of this report by clicking **Download** in the top right!

   ![image-20250730-171752.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-teams-report/image-20250730-171752.png)

Please note that the following information is found in the **Excel**Teams Report:

* Name of team captain

* Email of team captain

* Emails of personal page creators

* Amount Raised (Total Raised Online + Total Received Offline)

* Amount Pledged (Any Pending Pledges and Offline Donations)

<!-- -->

* Answers to Custom Questions

## Restoring a Deleted Team Page

To restore a team page which was deleted, simply click the 'triple dot' icon to the right of the page marked as 'Deleted' (see tag in red), and click '**Restore**' as shown in screenshot below.  
![image-20230714-150019.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-teams-report/image-20230714-150019.png)

Then click '**Yes**' within the prompt that appears:  
![yes3.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-teams-report/yes3.png)

The team page owner will receive an email notification letting them know that their team has been restored.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-edit-email-notifications | Nav: How to Edit Email Notifications | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Edit Email Notifications

You have the ability to decide which email notifications you receive via your **My Notifications**page.

From there you can also set your preferred language for notifications, and unsubscribe from all if desired.

To access this page, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Notifications**.

   ![image-20250709-150255.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-150255.png)

3. Turn off any undesired notifications by clicking the relevant toggle sliders. (Further explanation below)

   ![image-20250709-151106.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-151106.png)

## Categories of Notifications

Notifications are sectioned off into the following categories (which of these you see will depend on your level of access and what type of pages you manage):

* **General**- Toggle on or off the 'Recurring donation receipt' - we recommend leaving this off, as you will receive a consolidated receipt at year-end for all your recurring donations.

![image-20250709-164254.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-164254.png)

* **My fundraisers activity**- Set which notifications you receive for the fundraisers you manage, such as 'New Donation Received', 'Donation Refunded', 'Milestone Notifications' and more.

  ![image-20250709-163922.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-163922.png)

* **My team activity**- Select which notifications you receive for your team page(s).

  ![myteamactivity.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/myteamactivity.png)
* **My personal page activity** - Select which notifications you receive for your personal page(s).

  ![image-20250709-164507.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-164507.png)

* **My banking notifications**- Select which (if any) banking-related notifications you receive.

  ![image-20250709-163853.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-163853.png)

* **Admin Notifications**- As an Admin user on your CrowdChange site, here is where you will go to set or adjust your site-wide notifications settings. Note that if you have many fundraisers on your site, these notifications may result in many emails, so you may want to disable some from here, for example, 'New Donation Received'.

  ![image-20250709-151106.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-151106.png)

For further information on CrowdChange Notifications and what exactly triggers them, check out [**this article**](crowdchange-notifications.md).

To unsubscribe from all notifications, click the toggle slider next to '**Turn off all notifications**' at the top.  
You can also get to**My Notifications** via the links at the bottom of our emails, as shown below:  
![Untitled.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/Untitled.png)

# CrowdChange Notifications

CrowdChange is equipped with a host of informative email notifications for each type of user role.

Here is an in-depth overview of existing notifications, their triggers, and which user roles are required to receive them.  

|                     **Notification Name**                     |                                                                                  **Trigger**                                                                                   |                      **Sent To**                       |
|---------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| *****Related to basic fundraiser actions*****                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |||
| Fundraiser created (Welcome / Confirmation)                   | Fundraiser created                                                                                                                                                             | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| New fundraiser created (Admin Notification)                   | Fundraiser created (maybe with pending approval status)                                                                                                                        | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Owner Invite                                       | Fundraiser created                                                                                                                                                             | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Fundraiser Approved                                           | Fundraiser approved by Admin                                                                                                                                                   | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Fundraiser Rejected                                           | Fundraiser rejected (not approved) by Admin                                                                                                                                    | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Fundraiser Updated (Admin Notification)                       | Fundraiser updated by an owner                                                                                                                                                 | * Site Admins                                          |
| New Personal Page Created (Admin Notification)                | Personal fundraising page created by a user                                                                                                                                    | * Site Admins                                          |
| Personal Page Created (Team Captain Notification)             | Personal fundraising page created by a user within a team                                                                                                                      | * Team Captain / Owner                                 |
| New Personal Page Created                                     | Personal fundraising page created by a user                                                                                                                                    | * Fundraiser owner * Personal page owner               |
| Personal Page Registered                                      | Personal fundraising page created by a user and registration paid (if "My event requires registration" option is selected in Fundraiser settings)                              | * Fundraiser owner * Personal page owner               |
| Personal Page Deleted                                         | Personal fundraising page deleted by a user                                                                                                                                    | * Site Admins                                          |
| Personal Page Restored                                        | Personal fundraising page restored by an admin                                                                                                                                 | * Personal page owner                                  |
| User Invite                                                   | Personal page created by an Admin or fundraiser owner                                                                                                                          | * General user (maybe even not registered)             |
| New Team Created (Admin Notification)                         | Team page created for fundraiser                                                                                                                                               | * Site Admins                                          |
| New Team Created                                              | Team page created for fundraiser                                                                                                                                               | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Team Deleted                                                  | Team fundraising page deleted by a user                                                                                                                                        | * Site Admins                                          |
| Team Restored                                                 | Team fundraising page restored by an admin                                                                                                                                     | * Team page owner / Team captain                       |
| Team Captain Invite                                           | Team page created for fundraiser                                                                                                                                               | * Team Captain / Owner                                 |
| Fundraiser Auto-Closed (Admin Notification)                   | Fundraiser closed automatically at a certain date / time (as set with the "Stop accepting funds on date" option).                                                              | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Auto-Opened (Admin Notification)                   | Fundraiser opened automatically at a certain date / time (as set with the "Start accepting funds on date" option).                                                             | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Managed Page Created                               | Personal page created through managed pages                                                                                                                                    | * Personal Page owner                                  |
| Fundraiser User Invite                                        | User invited to manage fundraiser                                                                                                                                              | * Invited user                                         |
| Fundraiser - Zero Raised                                      | Sent when fundraiser is created but hasn't raised any money in \[x\] (5/10/15) days. Only sent to Campus and HQ site types.                                                    | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Upcoming Event                                                | Sent \[x\] (4/7) days before the event. There are 2 different templates - one for events that sell tickets, and one for regular events. Only sent to Campus and HQ site types. | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Fundraiser Support Message (Admin Notification)               | User has a technical or refund request and clicks the Contact Us button (without addressing to the host).                                                                      | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Support Message                                    | User has a fundraiser-related question and clicks the Contact Us button (with question for the host option).                                                                   | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Milestone Notification                                        | Automatically sent out on set triggers.                                                                                                                                        | * Depends on trigger                                   |
| *****Related to additional fundraiser options*****                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |||
| Test Mode Enabled (Admin Notification)                        | Test mode enabled for a fundraiser (fundraiser not shown to general public)                                                                                                    | * Site Admins                                          |
| Test Mode Disabled (Admin Notification)                       | Test mode disabled for a fundraiser                                                                                                                                            | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Archived (Admin Notification)                      | Fundraiser archived by a fundraiser owner (fundraiser closed and hidden from the list of fundraisers)                                                                          | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser restored from archive (Admin Notification)         | Fundraiser restored from archive by a fundraiser owner (it will remain closed, but shown in the list of fundraisers, FO is able to re-open it as well)                         | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Closed (Admin Notification)                        | Fundraiser closed by an owner (stop collecting donations)                                                                                                                      | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Re-opened (Admin Notification)                     | Fundraiser re-opened by an owner (start collecting donations again)                                                                                                            | * Site Admins                                          |
| Fundraiser Deleted (Admin Notification)                       | Fundraiser deleted by an owner                                                                                                                                                 | * Site Admins                                          |
| Event stopped ticket sale (Admin Notification)                | Ticket sale stopped for an event by fundraiser owner (donations still collected, but tickets not available)                                                                    | * Site Admins                                          |
| Event re-opened ticket sale (Admin Notification)              | Ticket sale re-opened for an event by fundraiser owner                                                                                                                         | * Site Admins                                          |
| eCard Copy                                                    | At the same time when original eCard is sent to recipient                                                                                                                      | * Donor (if send me a copy is selected)                |
| eCard                                                         | eCard purchased \& sent (Not a notification, but the eCard itself)                                                                                                             | * eCard Recipient                                      |
| eCard Sent                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                                | * Donor (as confirmation)                              |
| Mail Template Custom                                          | New email template created (with Mailing List or Milestone type)                                                                                                               | * As specified in a Fundraiser Mailing List            |
| Payment Link                                                  | Link for pending Offline Donation requested from interface                                                                                                                     | * Certain email owner                                  |
| Scanner Email                                                 | Sent out when someone invites a ticket scanner to their event                                                                                                                  | * Fundraiser owner * User invited to be Ticket Scanner |
| Tribute Copy                                                  | At the same time as original tribute is sent to recipient (when completing a donation if purchasing cards were required)                                                       | * Donor                                                |
| Tribute                                                       | When completing a donation if purchasing cards were required                                                                                                                   | * Personal page's owner                                |
| Subscription Auto-Cancelled                                   | Recurring donations were cancelled as campaign stopped                                                                                                                         | * Fundraiser owner * Donor                             |
| Subscription Cancelled (Admin Notification)                   | Recurring donations were cancelled                                                                                                                                             | * Site Admins                                          |
| Subscription Cancelled                                        | Recurring donations were cancelled                                                                                                                                             | * Fundraiser owner * Donor (as confirmation)           |
| Subscription - Card Expiring Soon (Admin Notification)        | Card linked to recurring donations will be expired soon (in \* days)                                                                                                           | * Site Admins                                          |
| Subscription - Card Expiring Soon                             | Card linked to recurring donations will be expired soon (in \* days)                                                                                                           | * Donor                                                |
| Subscription - Card Was Updated                               | Card linked to recurring donations was updated (expiry date or CVS/CVV changed)                                                                                                | * Donor (as confirmation)                              |
| Subscription Changed (Admin Notification)                     | Recurring donation date was changed                                                                                                                                            | * Site Admins                                          |
| Subscription Changed                                          | Recurring donation date was changed                                                                                                                                            | * Donor (as confirmation)                              |
| Subscription - Recurring Donation Failed (Admin Notification) | Transaction could not be processed (3 more tries then it will be cancelled)                                                                                                    | * Site Admins                                          |
| Subscription - Recurring Donation Failed                      | Transaction could not be processed (3 more tries then it will be cancelled)                                                                                                    | * Donor                                                |
| Subscription Charge Error - Cancelled (Admin Notification)    | Transaction cancelled after 3 additional tries to process                                                                                                                      | * Site Admins                                          |
| Subscription Charge Error - Cancelled                         | Transaction cancelled after 3 additional tries to process                                                                                                                      | * Donor                                                |
| *****Related to reports and transactions*****                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |||
| Daily Summary                                                 | Sent out every morning (contains summary of amounts raised, teams and pages created for previous day)                                                                          | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Monthly Summary                                               | Sent out every 1st day of month in the morning (contains summary of amounts raised, teams and pages created for previous month)                                                | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Weekly Summary                                                | Sent out every Monday morning (contains summary of amounts raised, teams and pages created for previous week)                                                                  | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| Daily Summary (Admin Notification)                            | Sent out every morning (contains summary of amounts raised, teams and pages created for all Site's fundraisers for previous day)                                               | * Site Admins                                          |
| Monthly Summary (Admin Notification)                          | Sent out every 1st day of month in the morning (contains summary of amounts raised, teams and pages created for all Site's fundraisers for previous month)                     | * Site Admins                                          |
| Weekly Summary (Admin Notification)                           | Sent out every Monday morning (contains summary of amounts raised, teams and pages created for all Site's fundraisers for previous week)                                       | * Site Admins                                          |
| New Donation Received (Admin Notification)                    | New donation was made for a fundraiser                                                                                                                                         | * Site Admins                                          |
| New Donation Received                                         | New donation was made for a fundraiser                                                                                                                                         | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| New Donation Received                                         | New donation was made for a personal page                                                                                                                                      | * Personal page owner                                  |
| New donation was made to your team page                       | New donation was made for a team page                                                                                                                                          | * Team owner                                           |
| Donation was disputed for my fundraiser                       |                                                                                                                                                                                | * Fundraiser Owner                                     |
| Donation disputed (Admin Notification)                        |                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                        |
| Dispute Reverted (Admin Notification)                         |                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                        |
| Donation was refunded                                         | Transaction was refunded                                                                                                                                                       | * Fundraiser owner * Donor (of certain transaction)    |
| Donation refunded (Admin Notification)                        | Transaction was refunded                                                                                                                                                       | * Site Admins                                          |
| Tax Receipt Ready                                             | Tax receipt for a certain transaction issued                                                                                                                                   | * Donor (of certain transaction)                       |
| Tax Receipt Reissued                                          | Tax receipt for a certain transaction re-issued                                                                                                                                | * Donor (of certain transaction)                       |
| Tax Receipt Voided (Admin Notification)                       | Tax receipt for a certain transaction voided                                                                                                                                   | * Site Admins                                          |
| Tax Receipt Voided                                            | Tax receipt for a certain transaction voided                                                                                                                                   | * Donor (of certain transaction)                       |
| Subscription - Annual Tax Receipt                             | Sent out in the beginning of a year from Tax Receipt report and includes attached annual tax receipt for recurring donations                                                   | * Donor                                                |
| Subscription - Recurring Donation Receipt                     | Sent for every instance of a recurring donation (optional)                                                                                                                     | * Donor                                                |
| ReportFundraisers                                             | Admin → Report → Fundraisers Report → Excel                                                                                                                                    | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| ReportPayout                                                  | Admin → Report → Payout Report → Excel                                                                                                                                         | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| ReportRegistrations                                           | Admin → Report → Registrations Report → Excel                                                                                                                                  | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| ReportSubscriptions                                           | Admin → Report → Recurring Donations Report → Excel                                                                                                                            | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| ReportSummary                                                 | Admin → Report → Summary Report → Excel                                                                                                                                        | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| ReportTaxReceipts                                             | Admin → Report → Tax Receipts Report → Excel                                                                                                                                   | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| ReportTaxReceiptsZipFile                                      | Admin → Report → Tax Receipts Report → Zip                                                                                                                                     | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| ReportTransactionsSummaryAdmin                                | Office → Transactions Report                                                                                                                                                   | * Whoever requested it                                 |
| TransactionCreatedMail                                        | Transaction created without email address                                                                                                                                      | * Fundraiser owner / Site admin                        |
| TransactionCreatedOwnerFirst                                  | The first donation was made for a fundraiser                                                                                                                                   | * Fundraiser owner                                     |
| TransactionRecurring                                          | New recurring donation was made for a fundraiser                                                                                                                               | * Donor                                                |
| *****Related to Payment Processing*****                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |||
| BraintreeDisputeCreated                                       |                                                                                                                                                                                | * Donor                                                |
| Payout Failed (Stripe)                                        |                                                                                                                                                                                | * Stripe account owner                                 |
| Funds deposited to my bank account (Payout Paid)              |                                                                                                                                                                                | * Stripe account owner                                 |
| Required billing info is missing                              |                                                                                                                                                                                | * Stripe account owner                                 |
| *****Accounts related*****                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |||
| TwoFactorCode                                                 | 2-Factor Authentication code request                                                                                                                                           | * User                                                 |
| LoginNewLocationNotification                                  | Office login from new location                                                                                                                                                 | * Office user                                          |
| Password Reset                                                | User requests a password reset via Log In menu                                                                                                                                 | * User                                                 |
| Verify Notification                                           | Verification request from user Profile or when setting up email templates (if account was not verified yet)                                                                    | * Certain email owner                                  |

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/recurring-donations | Nav: Recurring Donations | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Recurring Donations

To get started with **Recurring Donations**, check out the steps below to learn how to do the following:

* Enable Recurring Donations on a Fundraiser and set the default donation type

* Edit Automated Email Templates connected to Recurring Donations

* Access your Profile to edit your Recurring Donations

Admin users can set a minimum amount for Recurring Donations via [**Admin → General Settings**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/Admin-%3E-General-Settings-(New-UI).2342453249.html?t=lsmx9P7KHk1WU6-3G11a4w).

They also have access to the **Recurring Donations Report** within **Admin → Reports**.

For more information, please see [**How to Access the Recurring Donations Report**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Recurring-Donations-Report.2342388178.html?t=lsmx9P7KHk1WU6-3G11a4w).

## Note on Tax Receipts for Recurring Donations

**Please note** that **Tax Receipts** for recurring donations are generated at year-end (First week of January of the following year) and are populated in your **Tax Receipts Report** automatically. All recurring donations for the year are consolidated into one tax receipt. These will show as 'Annual'. These receipts are **not** sent to donor's automatically. Site admins are able to either send these using automated communication via the **Tax Receipts Report** , or download and send these receipts manually however they choose. Donors will be able to access these receipts via their **Profile**.

## Getting Started with Recurring Donations

### Enable Recurring Donations on a Fundraiser and set the default donation type

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser** , then**Donation Settings**.

   ![managefundraiserpls.png](../assets/recurring-donations/managefundraiserpls.png)  
   ![donation settings.png](../assets/recurring-donations/donation_settings.png)
2. Click **Donation amounts \& types**as shown above.

3. Enable **Accept Recurring Donations** , then specify your **Accepted Donation Types** , **Default Donation Type** , and **Minimum Recurring Donation Amount**. For example:

   ![image-20231028-180709.png](../assets/recurring-donations/image-20231028-180709.png)
4. ***Optional*** *- if desired, you can also set default donation amounts and impact statements for each type of donation you have enabled. To set monthly and annual donation amounts, scroll down to this section:*

   ![image-20231028-181106.png](../assets/recurring-donations/image-20231028-181106.png)
5. At the bottom of the page, click **Save** to confirm.

### Edit Automated Email Templates connected to Recurring Donations

1. From your fundraiser, go to **Manage Fundraiser →** **Automated Email Templates**.

2. Click on any template you want to edit and toggle on**I want to use my own text**.

   ![recurringdonationreceipt.png](../assets/recurring-donations/recurringdonationreceipt.png)
3. Edit the subject and message body as desired and click **Save**.

4. *Optional: You can send yourself a* ***Preview Email*** *or* ***Reset*** *the message to default by clicking the respective buttons.*

### Access your Profile to update your Recurring Donations

1. From anywhere on your CrowdChange site, click **Profile** in in the top right, then**My Profile**

2. Select**My Recurring Donations** from the left sidebar.

3. For any recurring donation in the list, you can perform the following actions:

   1. **Change Amount** *- Note that if a minimum recurring donation amount is set at the* [*Admin \> General Settings*](admin-general-settings.md)*level, you are not able to set the amount lower than this number.*

   2. **Change Payment Day**

   3. **Skip Next Payment**

   4. **Pause \& Resume Recurring Donation**

   5. **Cancel Recurring Donation**

      ![image-20240821-163917.png](/__attachments/a_95dc17b4db9923cc44a90d16d6d14e7a0f76b57347022a18334ed770538b0ca9/image-20240821-163917.png?cb=7573ac5f05bce8f122a26964699efbea)
4. To update your payment method (credit / debit card), click the pencil icon next to the last 4 digits of your card number at the top of the recurring donation. Enter the new details and click **Save**to confirm.

If you would like to receive email notification for every recurring donation charge, you can enable this from **Profile \> Notifications \> General Notifications**

## If a Recurring Donation Fails...

In cases where a Recurring Donation fails (for example: credit card has expired or amount exceeds limit), we will try to process the transaction again at a later date according to this timeline:

* **1st Failure** → Notification email is sent to donor and Admin, advising that the charge failed and why. Retry in 3 days is scheduled.

* **2nd Failure** → Retry in 7 days is scheduled.

* **3rd Failure** → Retry in 7 days is scheduled.

* **4th Failure** → Retry in 7 days is scheduled.

* **If Rety 4 fails** , Recurring Donation is *Paused* - email notification will be sent to the donor stating that this donation has been paused, and that it can be resumed via the **Profile** section.

================================================================================

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring | Nav: Recurring Donations Report - How to Manage Recurring Donations on CrowdChange | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Recurring Donations Report - How to Manage Recurring Donations on CrowdChange

As a site Admin, the **Recurring Donations Report** gives you a detailed list of all subscriptions across your CrowdChange site, and allows you to update them on behalf of your donors. (See: [**Recurring Donations**](recurring-donations.md)).

You can update the card details, change the recurring donation amount, the payment day, skip a payment, and pause, resume or cancel a recurring donation. **Please note** that you can not change a donation amount to be less than the minimum set at the [**Admin \> General Settings**](admin-general-settings.md)level.

To access this report, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click your name in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Recurring Donations Report**using the left sidebar. You will be taken here:

![image-20260128-170010.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-170010.png)
View of the **Recurring donations report** within the **Admin dashboard**

*** ** * ** ***

## Subscription statuses

There are five statuses that a recurring donation can have. They are as follows:

* **Active** - this means that a subscription is active, and will be processed at the rate selected by the donor (monthly or annually).

* **Paused** - this means that the subscription is still active, but payments are Paused. Donors can Pause or Resume their paused donation via their **Profile** . Site admins can Pause or Resume a paused subscription via the **Recurring donations report**.

* **Cancelled** - this means that a subscription has been manually cancelled, either by the donor or a site admin. Cancelled subscriptions cannot be resumed - if a donor wants to subscribe again, they would need to initiate a new subscription by making a new transaction.

* **Failed** - this means that a subscription has been cancelled automatically due to a failed transaction. Transactions are retried at a set rate prior to failing, outlined below in the **Retry settings** section. Like the **Cancelled**status, this transaction cannot be resumed.

* **Retrying** - a subscription marked retrying has had at least one transaction attempted, but has failed thus far. The transaction is not marked as failed yet as the **Retry settings** has not yet gone through all attempts.

Site admins can filter for the above statuses by clicking **Status** beside the search bar at the top of the **Recurring donations report** page (see below).  
![image-20260128-171515.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-171515.png)
The **Status** filtering options on the **Recurring donations report**

Site admins can also track **expiring credit cards** by using the **Card expiry**filter shown below:  
![image-20260128-171833.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-171833.png)
The **Card expiry**filter in the recurring donations report

This can help site admins track donations at risk of failure due to card expiration.  
Some payment processors include a feature that automatically updates credit card information for recurring donations when a card is renewed, as long as the details remain consistent. This helps prevent interruptions in monthly/annual giving. For more information on whether or not your account is already using this function, please contact your Partner Success Manager.

*** ** * ** ***

## Changing a recurring donation

If you would like to change the **amount** , **frequency** , **payment information** , or **status** of a recurring gift, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange site and log in to your account with Admin access

* Click your name in the upper right-hand corner of your screen, then click **Admin**

* From the **Admin dashboard** , click **Reports** , then **Recurring donations report**

* Once on the **Recurring donations report**, find the donation you want to adjust either by scrolling or searching

* Once you have found the donation in question, click the three dots on the right hand side of the donation

You will then be met with the following options:  
![image-20260128-173043.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-173043.png)
Clicking the **three-dot** menu on a recurring donation provides the following options

You can adjust the amount, frequency and timing of said donation (see below) by clicking **Edit subscription**.  
![image-20260128-172748.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-172748.png)
View of the **Edit subscription** options within the **Recurring donations report**

You can also update the payment method (change card) of the recurring donation by selecting **Change payment method**.

You can elect to **Skip next payment** if you want to maintain the subscription, but opt out of the next scheduled payment.

You can **Pause**the subscription, which maintains the ability to resume in the future, but stops payments from occuring as scheduled until manually resumed.

Finally, you can **Cancel** the recurring donation outright, which stops the subscription. Please note a cancelled subscription cannot be renewed.

*** ** * ** ***

## Retry settings

The **Retry settings** page allows you to set the schedule that additional payment attempts are charged to a donor's credit card after a scheduled recurring payment fails. You can set up to **five** retry attempts for a failed transaction. After all five attempts have failed, a subscription is set as **Paused**. No further retries will be attempted unless the subscription is manually resumed.

To access and set up your **Retry settings**, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange site and log in to your account with Admin access

* Click your name in the upper right-hand corner of your screen, then click **Admin**

* From the **Admin dashboard** , click **Reports** , then **Recurring donations report**

* Once on the **Recurring donations report** , click **Retry settings**

![image-20260128-174446.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-174446.png)
View of the **Retry settings** options within the **Recurring donations report**

Once on this page you can set up to five retry attempts based on the schedule that best suits your organization.

*** ** * ** ***

## Recurring donation details - breaking down a subscription

Within the **Recurring donations report** , you can see a breakdown of an individual subscription by clicking **View**.  
![image-20260128-183844.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-183844.png)
Click **View** on a specific donation to be taken to the **Recurring donation details** page

This includes:

* Donation amount

* Frequency

* Which fundraiser the donation has been made to

* When the subscription was created (first payment date)

* When the next payment is scheduled

* Record of attempted transactions that have failed (if applicable)

* Links to individual transaction details for each payment

* Credit card type

* Last four digits of credit card number

![image-20260128-174752.png](../assets/recurring-donations-report-how-to-manage-recurring/image-20260128-174752.png)

Clicking the three dot menu on this page also allows the same update options listed in the above section.

*** ** * ** ***

**IMPORTANT:** Please note that **Tax Receipts** for recurring donations are generated at year-end (First week of January of the following year) and are populated in your Tax Receipts Report automatically. All recurring donations for the year are consolidated into one tax receipt. These receipts are **NOT** sent to donors automatically - you can send these receipts manually by downloading the receipts , or send these receipts using pre-built automated emails in the **Tax receipts report**.

# Tax Receipts & Eligibility

## **Canada \& US Tax Eligibility**

Our point-of-purchase tax receipt functionality is available for both **CA** and **US**partners!  
You also have the option to set up **both**on your CrowdChange site, so you have the ability to issue both CRA and IRS compliant Tax Receipts, depending on the Billing Address of the donor.

To get started, you will need to complete the sections below:

* **Admin Tax Receipt Settings**

* **Fundraiser Tax Receipt Settings**

Below, you will also find information on **Split Receipting** , what to do if a **Tax Receipt was not issued** , and instructions on how to **Issue** , **Re-Issue** , and **Void**Tax Receipts.

Please click the relevant box below to view accurate information, instructions, and troubleshooting steps for your country:
For CA Partners  

### **Admin Tax Receipt Settings**

To enter all the information for your Tax Receipt, follow these instructions:

1. From your CrowdChange site, click **Profile → Admin** and then **Tax Receipt Settings** on the left sidebar.

2. Fill in your **Charity Registration Number** , **Issuing Location** , and **Authorized Signatory name**

3. Include on Tax Receipt**Fundraiser Name** , **In Support of Value** and/or **Fund code**

4. Add your organization's **Logo Image**.

   1. *Recommended image size is 500 x 150 pixels, with 16:9 aspect ratio.*

5. Add your **Signature Image**.

   1. *Recommended image size is 500 x 150 pixels, with 16:9 aspect ratio.*

6. Enter **Contact / Additional Information**.

7. Enter**Prefix** - A String to prefix your Tax Receipt numbers. New prefixes will begin at the specified sequence start.

8. Enter**Sequence Start** - The Numerical starting value of your Tax Receipt numbers.

9. Enter**Minimum Length**- The minimum length of your Tax Receipt numbers. For example, if you specify a minimum length of five, and your prefix value is "CC-" the first tax receipt number (if starting from 1) would be CC-00001.

10. Include French version for Tax Receipt - Option to 'Always' or "just for Quebec Residents only'.

### **Fundraiser Tax Receipt Settings**

Please note that in order to issue Tax Receipts for a fundraiser, the **Donations are tax deductible** option **MUST** be turned **ON** under **Advanced Features** on the **Additional Settings** page.  
![taxdeductible2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/taxdeductible2.png)

Additionally, if Tax Receipts are enabled on your CrowdChange site, you will be able to set:

1. Minimum Donation required for a Tax Receipt:

   1. From your CrowdChange site, click **Profile \> Admin** and then **General Settings** on the left hand side.

   2. Toggle on **Set Minimum Amount for Tax Receipts** and enter an amount, e.g $10.

2. If a Minimum donation amount is set on a Parent site, the child site will follow the same minimum donation amount as the Parent.

3. Taxable expenses are enabled on Tickets, Apparel and Registrations.

Once a fundraiser is created, the following rules must be met in order to change these settings.

**To be able to:**

* Turn ON / OFF tax receipt settings

* Change Expense amounts for tickets, apparel, registration

* Change minimum donation amount required to tax receipt to be issued

**At least one of the following conditions must be met:**

* Fundraiser must be in **Pending** state.

* User must be a **Full Admin** , or have **Manage Fundraisers** admin permission.

* User must be managing fundraiser's banking on a non-"Global Banking" CrowdChange Site.

### **Split Receipting**

A Charity can issue tax receipts for a fundraiser selling tickets/registration/apparel. They will have the option to add an "expense" field next to the price of each item.

If a ticket is sold for $200, but the Expense, defined as the true cost of that ticket to the charity before they markup the price (also known as Fair Market Value (FMV) or Benefit Amount), is $50, a tax receipt will automatically be issued for $150.

So if a dinner gala ticket is sold for $200 but the cost to the charity for hosting the dinner is $50 per person, they would enter $50 in the Expense field in CrowdChange, and we would instantaneously issue tax receipts for $150 for this ticket item.

### **Tax Receipt not Issued**

**If a tax receipt was not issued, go through this checklist:**

1. Was the tax-receipting feature enabled on that fundraiser? Each fundraiser needs to have the **Donations are tax deductible** feature enabled under **Advanced Features** on the **Additional Settings**page, in order for tax receipts to be issued. See below:

   ![taxdeductible2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/taxdeductible2.png)
2. Did the donation reach the threshold required by the charity in order to receive a tax receipt? You can check this by logging in, clicking **Profile \> Admin \> General Settings** and scrolling down to check.

   **Remember**: If someone buys a $20 ticket and the expense field for that ticket is set to $15, that ticket will only count for $5 towards reaching an $18 threshold. This means if someone donates $10 and buys 1 ticket, they will not receive a tax receipt. If someone donates $15 and buy a ticket, they will be eligible for a tax receipt.
3. Was the donation a recurring donation? If yes, tax receipts for these donations are generated at **year-end** (in January) and sent to donors automatically. The reason for this is so that, if someone is making $20 monthly donations, instead of us sending them 12 x $20 tax receipts, they will simply get 1 x $240 tax receipt. We will consolidate all the recurring donation amounts into one tax receipt.

4. Was the donation made by an American address? If yes, we **do not** automatically issue them Canadian tax receipts. US Tax Receipts will only be automatically issued if they have been set up on the site.

### **Admin User Issuing Tax Receipts**

Tax receipts can be manually issued on a transaction-by-transaction basis via the Admin Donations Report of your CrowdChange site. Feel free to follow the steps below to do so:

1. From your CrowdChange site click **Profile** , then **Admin** in the top right corner of the page.

2. Click **Reports** , then **Donations Report** from the left sidebar.

3. Any transactions that have not been issued a tax receipt will say '**No**' next to them under the Tax Receipt column.

4. Use the search bar at the top of the page to find your desired transaction, and click on it to open the transaction window.

5. Click**Issue Tax Receipt** and confirm all information is correct in the window that appears.

6. Click **Issue** at the bottom of the page and the receipt will be sent to the email address entered in the previous step.

![issue1.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/issue1.png)  
![issue2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/issue2.png)

### **Admin User Reissuing a Tax Receipt through Donations Report**

Tax Receipts can be re-issued via the Donations Report, should you need to change any details on the Tax Receipt.

1. From your CrowdChange site, click **Profile** , then **Admin** in the top right corner of the page.

2. Click **Reports** , then **Donations Report** from the left sidebar.

3. Use the search bar at the top of the page to find your desired transaction, and click on it to open the transaction window.

4. Click**Re-issue Tax Receipt** and fill out all necessary information in the window that appears.

5. Click **Reissue** at the bottom of the page and a receipt will be sent to the email address entered in the previous step.

![reissue2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/reissue2.png)  
![reissue3.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/reissue3.png)

### **Admin User Resending / Reissuing / Voiding / Tax Receipts through Tax Receipts Report**

Tax Receipts can be re-issued, re-sent and marked as void via the Tax Receipts report, should you need to change any details on the Tax Receipt.

1. From your CrowdChange site click **Profile** , then **Admin** in the top right corner of the page.

2. Click **Reports** , then **Tax Receipt Report** from the left hand side menu.

3. Use the search bar and/or filters at the top of the page to find your desired transaction, and click on it to open the transaction window.

4. Click **Resend Tax Receipt** ,**Issue Tax Receipt** , or **Void**as needed.

![functions.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/functions.png)  
Notifications are sent to both the donor and to site Admins when tax receipts are voided.

You can also enter a reason the tax receipt is being voided.
For US Partners  

## **US Tax Eligibility**

Our point-of-purchase tax receipt functionality is also available for **US** partners!  
Please note that this feature is **NOT**enabled by default, and you will need to reach out to your Partner Success Representative if you would like to use it.

Once we have enabled this feature on your site, you will need to complete the sections below:

* **Admin Tax Receipt Settings**

* **Fundraiser Tax Receipt Settings**

### **Admin Tax Receipt Settings**

To enter all the information for your Tax Receipt, follow these instructions:

1. From your CrowdChange site, click **Profile \> Admin** and then **Tax Receipt Settings** on the left sidebar.

2. Fill in your **EIN (Employer Identification Number)** , **Issuing Location** , and **Authorized Signatory name**

3. Include on Tax Receipts**Fundraiser Name** , **In Support of Value** and/or **Fund code**

4. Add your organization's **Logo Image**.

   1. *Recommended image size is 500 x 150 pixels, with 16:9 aspect ratio.*

5. Add your **Signature Image**.

   1. *Recommended image size is 500 x 150 pixels, with 16:9 aspect ratio.*

6. Enter **Contact / Additional Information**

7. Enter**Prefix** - A String to prefix your Tax Receipt numbers. New prefixes will begin at the specified sequence start.

8. Enter**Sequence Start** - The Numerical starting value of your Tax Receipt numbers.

9. Enter**Minimum Length**- The minimum length of your Tax Receipt numbers. For example, if you specify a minimum length of five, and your prefix value is "CC-" the first tax receipt number (if starting from 1) would be CC-00001.

10. Click **Save Changes**

### **Fundraiser Tax Receipt Settings**

Please note that in order to issue Tax Receipts for a fundraiser, the **Donations are tax deductible** option **MUST** be turned **ON** under **Advanced Features** on the **Additional Settings** page.  
![taxdeductible2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/taxdeductible2.png)

Additionally, if Tax Receipts are enabled on your CrowdChange site, you will be able to set:

1. Minimum Donation required for a Tax Receipt:

   1. From your CrowdChange site, click **Profile \> Admin** and then **General Settings** on the left hand side.

   2. Toggle on **Set Minimum Amount for Tax Receipts** and enter an amount, e.g $10.

2. If a Minimum donation amount is set on a Parent site, the child site will follow the same minimum donation amount as the Parent.

3. Taxable expenses are enabled on Tickets, Apparel and Registrations.

Once a fundraiser is created, the following rules must be met in order to change these settings.

**To be able to:**

* Turn ON / OFF tax receipt settings

* Change Expense amounts for tickets, apparel, registration

* Change minimum donation amount required to tax receipt to be issued

**At least one of the following conditions must be met:**

* Fundraiser must be in **Pending** state.

* User must be a **Full Admin** , or have **Manage Fundraisers** admin permission.

* User must be managing fundraiser's banking on a non-"Global Banking" CrowdChange Site.

### **Split Receipting**

An organization can issue tax receipts for a fundraiser selling tickets/registration/apparel. They will have the option to add an "expense" field next to the price of each item.

If a ticket is sold for $200, but the Expense, defined as the true cost of that ticket to the organization before they markup the price (also known as Fair Market Value (FMV) or Benefit Amount), is $50, a tax receipt will automatically be issued for $150.

So if a dinner gala ticket is sold for $200 but the cost to the organization for hosting the dinner is $50 per person, they would enter $50 in the Expense field in CrowdChange, and we would instantaneously issue tax receipts for $150 for this ticket item.

### **Tax Receipt not Issued**

**If a tax receipt was not issued, go through this checklist:**

1. Was the tax-receipting feature enabled on that fundraiser? Each fundraiser needs to have the **Donations are tax deductible** feature enabled under **Advanced Features** on the **Additional Settings**page, in order for tax receipts to be issued. See below:

   ![taxdeductible2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/taxdeductible2.png)
2. Did the donation reach the threshold required by the charity in order to receive a tax receipt? You can check this by logging in, clicking **Profile \> Admin \> General Settings** and scrolling down to check.

   **Remember**: If someone buys a $20 ticket and the expense field for that ticket is set to $15, that ticket will only count for $5 towards reaching an $18 threshold. This means if someone donates $10 and buys 1 ticket, they will not receive a tax receipt. If someone donates $15 and buy a ticket, they will be eligible for a tax receipt.
3. Was the donation a recurring donation? If yes, tax receipts for these donations are generated at **year-end** (in January) and sent to donors automatically. The reason for this is so that, if someone is making $20 monthly donations, instead of us sending them 12 x $20 tax receipts, they will simply get 1 x $240 tax receipt. We will consolidate all the recurring donation amounts into one tax receipt.

4. Are US Tax Receipts enabled and set up on this CrowdChange site? US Tax Receipts will only be automatically issued if they have been set up on the site.

### **Admin User Issuing Tax Receipts**

Tax receipts can be manually issued on a transaction-by-transaction basis via the Admin Donations Report of your CrowdChange site. Feel free to follow the steps below to do so:

1. From your CrowdChange site click **Profile** , then **Admin** in the top right corner of the page.

2. Click **Reports** , then **Donations Report** from the left sidebar.

3. Any transactions that have not been issued a tax receipt will say '**No**' next to them under the Tax Receipt column.

4. Use the search bar at the top of the page to find your desired transaction, and click on it to open the transaction window.

5. Click**Issue Tax Receipt** and fill out all necessary information in the window that appears.

6. Click **Issue** at the bottom of the page and the receipt will be sent to the email address entered in the previous step.

![issue1.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/issue1.png)  
![issue2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/issue2.png)

### **Admin User Reissuing a Tax Receipt through Donations Report**

Tax Receipts can be re-issued via the Donations Report, should you need to change any details on the Tax Receipt.

1. From your CrowdChange site, click **Profile** , then **Admin** in the top right corner of the page.

2. Click **Reports** , then **Donations Report** from the left sidebar.

3. Use the search bar at the top of the page to find your desired transaction, and click on it to open the transaction window.

4. Click**Re-issue Tax Receipt** and fill out all necessary information in the window that appears.

5. Click **Reissue** at the bottom of the page and a receipt will be sent to the email address entered in the previous step.

![reissue2.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/reissue2.png)  
![reissue3.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/reissue3.png)

### **Admin User Resending / Reissuing / Voiding / Tax Receipts through Tax Receipts Report**

Tax Receipts can be re-issued, re-sent and marked as void via the Tax Receipts report, should you need to change any details on the Tax Receipt.

1. From your CrowdChange site click **Profile** , then **Admin** in the top right corner of the page.

2. Click **Reports** , then **Tax Receipt Report** from the left hand side menu.

3. Use the search bar and/or filters at the top of the page to find your desired transaction, and click on it to open the transaction window.

4. Click **Resend Tax Receipt** ,**Re-Issue Tax Receipt** , or **Void Tax Receipt**as needed.

![functions.png](../assets/tax-receipts-eligibility/functions.png)  
Notifications are sent to both the donor and to site Admins when tax receipts are voided.

You can also enter a reason the tax receipt is being voided.
