<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/fundraiser-link-displays-page-not-found-error-mess | Nav: Fundraiser link displays 'Page not Found' Error message | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Fundraiser link displays 'Page not Found' Error message

If you have shared or visited a CrowdChange link and are seeing a '*Page not Found*' screen (otherwise known as "Error 404"), below are some possible reasons why:

* [**Banking**](stripe-banking-overview.md)information on the fundraiser has not been set up/verified by the payment processor (Stripe).

* The fundraiser is pending [**Approval**](fundraiser-approval-admins.md) from site admins.

* Incorrect URL: This is caused by mistyping or misspelling a URL.

* The page you are trying to view has been deleted and doesn't exist anymore.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/double-the-donation-integration | Nav: Double the Donation Integration | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Double the Donation Integration

CrowdChange now integrates with the '**Double the Donation**' donation matching platform.

Double the Donation helps nonprofits increase revenue by providing technology and resources to take advantage of matching gift programs in the corporate space. Many nonprofits miss out on revenue simply because donors are unaware of their employers' matching gift programs.

This integration allows donors to your CrowdChange fundraisers to select their company before checkout, learn whether or not they have a matching gift program, and find out how to apply for it.

Here is the prompt donors will see at checkout **before**completing their donation:  
![image-20231018-163803.png](../assets/double-the-donation-integration/image-20231018-163803.png)

And here is an example of company donation matching information they could see **after**checkout:  
![image-20231018-160054.png](../assets/double-the-donation-integration/image-20231018-160054.png)  
![image-20231018-160120.png](../assets/double-the-donation-integration/image-20231018-160120.png)  
![image-20231018-160140.png](../assets/double-the-donation-integration/image-20231018-160140.png)  
![image-20231018-160158.png](../assets/double-the-donation-integration/image-20231018-160158.png)

## How to Set Up 'Double the Donation' on your CrowdChange Site

**Please Note:** This integration is **NOT**available by default and must first be enabled on your site by your CrowdChange Partner Success Representative. You will also be required to set up a Double the Donation account in order can use this integration. Please reach out to your Partner Success Representative today to be connected.

Once the integration has been enabled on your CrowdChange site, follow the steps below:

1. From anywhere on your CrowdChange site, click**Profile \> Admin**in the top right corner.

2. On the left sidebar that appears, click**Integrations \> Double the Donation Integration**

3. Toggle on '**Enable Integration** ' and enter your **Public** \& **Private**API keys, which you will receive from your Double the Donation representative.

4. Click **Save** to confirm. Once everything is correct, you should see the below:

   ![image-20231018-163651.png](../assets/double-the-donation-integration/image-20231018-163651.png)

### Enabling 'Double the Donation' at the fundraiser level

'Double the Donation' integration must next be enabled at the individual fundraiser level.

This can only be done by Admin users on your CrowdChange site.

1. Go to your specific fundraiser on CrowdChange while logged in.

2. Click '**Manage Fundraiser** ', then **Integration Settings** on the left sidebar.

3. Click **Double the Donation** , then enable **Import to Double the Donation**.

   ![image-20240821-192827.png](../assets/double-the-donation-integration/image-20240821-192827.png)
4. Once completed, your checkout page will have the 'Double the Donation' prompt and functionality.

This setting can also be toggled on within Blueprints in the same way.

# How to Use Embedded Donation Forms

Using our Embedded Donation Forms feature, you have the ability to insert a streamlined CrowdChange donation form directly into your website or landing page.  
**Please Note:** This feature is **NOT**enabled by default - Reach out to your Partner Success Representative today to request it be activated on your CrowdChange site!

Using this feature, visitors to your website won't need to be redirected to CrowdChange in order to make a donation - they can do so directly from the embedded donation form on your website.  
![image-20230915-165818.png](../assets/how-to-use-embedded-donation-forms/image-20230915-165818.png)

Embedded Donation Forms also introduce **Impact Statements**, where shorthand text and an image showing tangible benefits connected to each donation amount are displayed during selection.

Each Embedded Donation Form is linked to a **Fundraiser**in CrowdChange with the 'Embed Donation Form' feature enabled. This is where you will go to set up the donation form, amounts, impact statements, check reports, and more.

## How to Set Up an Embeddable Donation Form

To set up an embeddable donation form, you need to enable the 'Embed donation form' feature on a CrowdChange fundraiser. We recommend setting up a fundraiser specifically to be used for this purpose.

Follow the simple steps below to do so:

1. Create a new CrowdChange fundraiser by clicking '**Start a Fundraiser** ' on your homepage and going through the [**Start a Fundraiser**](how-to-start-a-fundraiser.md) process.

2. Ensure to toggle on '**Enable embedded donation form**' on the General Info page.

3. Once the fundraiser is created, go to **Manage Fundraiser → Donation settings**.

4. Click **Donation amounts \& types**.

5. ***Optional*** *: Enable '* ***Accept Recurring Donations*** *' and specify accepted donation types and min. amounts.*

   ![donationsettings1.png](../assets/how-to-use-embedded-donation-forms/donationsettings1.png)
   1. Enable our recurring donation upsell feature by toggling on '**Encourage one-time donors to upgrade to recurring donations**'.

      ![image-20240705-145322.png](/__attachments/a_fc117a172283132b6d786f5e2d066def29d9f7e1ec0ee8d1fa7bb9391209c12d/image-20240705-145322.png?cb=c856460695fcd348528861906c366a4f)
6. Set up amount-specific impact statements and images as desired.

   1. *Note that these can be set independently for Recurring Donations.*

7. ![image-20230920-154547.png](../assets/how-to-use-embedded-donation-forms/image-20230920-154547.png)

   Scroll down to the bottom and click **Save**.  
   ![image-20230920-154738.png](../assets/how-to-use-embedded-donation-forms/image-20230920-154738.png)

## How to Embed the Donation Form on your Website

To embed the Donation Form in your website, you will need to follow the steps below:  
May require some familiarity with HTML code.

1. Go to **Manage Fundraiser → Donation Settings → Embedded Donation Form**, and set a Title, Description, Accent Colour and Image.

2. Click **Save** at the bottom, then **Copy**the first provided code snippet for the embedded form.

   ![image-20230920-161546.png](../assets/how-to-use-embedded-donation-forms/image-20230920-161546.png)
3. **Paste** the first code snippet before `</body>` tag on your website (it should look like the below):

    <script type="module" crossorigin src="https://[your-site-domain]/js/[campaign-id]/embed.js"></script>

This will make the donation form available for use either on a specific page, or across your entire website.

4. **Add** the`cc-open-donation-form` class (the second code snippet) to any element you want to use to open the donation form.

   1. For Example, to add your donation form in a new HTML text element called ***'Donate'***, copy and paste the code snippet below:

          <a href="#" class="cc-open-donation-form">Donate</a>

   2. To add the donation for into an existing HTML element on your website, you can simply add the ***\`cc-open-donation-form\`*** class to the element that you want to open the donation form. In the code snippet below, this has been added into an existing button on the website:

          <a data-display-type="block" class="u_1491401495 dmButtonLink dmWidget dmWwr default dmOnlyButton cc-open-donation-form"

You may use additional parameters, such as `lang` to set language. See the table in the following section to learn more.

### Adding Multiple Donation Forms to the Same Website

If you have created multiple donation forms within your CrowdChange site, they can be embedded into your website by following these steps:

1. **Navigate** to the Embedded Donation Form Settings page of the additional donation form(s).

2. **Copy and Paste** the first code snippet before \</body\> tag of the specific page you would like the form to be available on.

   1. For example, if there is a sub-page within your website titled 'Become A Monthly Donor', you will need to paste this code snippet before the \</body\> tag of this page.

3. Follow **Steps 4 A and B** in the above section to either add a new HTML element with your donation form, or embed the form into an existing HTML element.

Multiple unique donation forms cannot be added to the same page within a website, and if your website uses a common footer (i.e. shared between multiple pages), this footer cannot share the code connected to multiple forms. In this case, the code for each embedded form must be added to the Body HTML of each specific page.

### Additional URL Parameters

The following parameters can be added to `/embed.js` as a query string.

For example, to set language to French, add `lang=fr` parameter to query string (`/embed.js?lang=fr`). See below for sample code snippets:

#### To pull in the French content setting in your Embedded Donation Form Settings:

    <script type="module" crossorigin src="https://[your-site-domain]/js/[fundraiser-id]/embed.js?lang=fr"></script>

#### To pull in the English content setting in your Embedded Donation Form Settings:

    <script type="module" crossorigin src="https://[your-site-domain]/js/[campaign-id]/embed.js?lang=en"></script>

| Parameter | Required? |   Allowed Values    |          Description           |
|-----------|-----------|---------------------|--------------------------------|
| lang      | Optional  | * EN (default) * FR | Language for the embedded form |

<https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/docs/embedded-forms>

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is there an additional cost to enable this on my CrowdChange site?**

A: No, there is no additional cost associated with embedded donation forms. You are free to use this at your convenience!

**Q: Will this feature be available on my CrowdChange site by default?**

A: This will need to be enabled by your Partner Success Representative.

**Q: Which payment processors can be used with embedded donation forms?**

A: In our Version 1 release, Stripe will be the only payment processor offered with embedded donation forms. Billhighway will be added in a subsequent release, but all other gateways are still in planning at this time.

**Q: Can a donation form be embedded into multiple elements on my website?**

A: Yes, a CrowdChange embedded donation form can be used on multiple elements across your website.

**Q: Can I host my eCard store via an embedded donation form?**

A: eCards are not currently supported within embedded donation forms, but Tribute cards for 'in honour'/'in memory' style campaigns are supported.

**Q: Where can I access reporting on donations made via an embedded form?**

A: Just as any other transaction processed on your CrowdChange site, donations made via embedded donation forms are processed through your existing Stripe integration, and the transaction/donor data is available within all fundraiser and admin-level reports.

# Donor Advised Funds - DAFpay by Chariot Integration

![IMG_5479.png](../assets/donor-advised-funds-dafpay-by-chariot-integration/IMG_5479.png)

DAFpay is a payment method powered by our partnership with[Chariot](https://www.givechariot.com/). It allows donors to make Donor Advised Fund (DAF) gifts directly within your CrowdChange donation forms. Major DAF providers are supported, including Fidelity, DAFGiving360, Vanguard, National Christian Foundation, and more.

## What is a Donor Advised Fund?

A Donor Advised Fund is a charitable savings account created solely to support nonprofit organizations that donors care about. When money, or more complex assets such as stock, crypto, or real estate, are deposited into a DAF, donors are immediately credited with a tax receipt and can then invest those funds, which grow tax-free. Donors can direct their DAF to make grants to 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations at any time. Additionally, using DAFpay by Chariot, these DAF donations can be made instantly and seamlessly online within a nonprofit's own donation forms. Donor Advised Funds are a rapidly growing giving channel, with $326B set aside for giving in DAFs (2024 year-end).

![What's a DAF.png](../assets/donor-advised-funds-dafpay-by-chariot-integration/What_s_a_DAF.png)

### **Key Benefits of Donor Advised Fund (DAF) Payments**

1. **Larger donations:** DAF funds are already set aside for charitable giving, and DAF gifts are often larger than typical online card donations.

2. **Ideal donor experience:** DAFpay reduces friction by keeping the DAF gift flow embedded in your donation experience.

3. **Identify DAF donors:** DAF donors can self-identify at the time of giving, helping your team steward these donors more effectively.

We're excited to offer this Donor Advised Fund payment option, which we believe will support your fundraising efforts and provide a more streamlined experience for your donors. If you have any questions or need guided assistance, feel free to reach out to our support team.

## How to Manage Your Chariot DAFpay Integration

DAFpay is enabled by default for all US-based partners, and you can opt out at any time by contacting our Customer Support Team. Send an email to [support@crowdchange.co](mailto:support@crowdchange.co) and our team would be happy to assist.

### Important: Claim and verify your Chariot account (recommended)

To manage incoming DAFpay gifts and avoid potential delays or fees, we strongly recommend that nonprofits claim and verify their Chariot account. This creates a Chariot Deposit Account (CDA).

If you do not have a CDA:

* DAFpay gifts may be routed through the DAFpay Network (DPN).

* Gifts routed via DPN may be subject to DPN terms, including a 60-day holding period and a check handling fee, the lesser of $25 or 10%.

Claim your Chariot account (CDA) here - <https://dashboard.givechariot.com/signup?fp=crowd-change>

*** ** * ** ***

### Making a Donation with DAFpay

Once setup is complete, DAFpay will be available as a payment option at checkout within your CrowdChange donation forms.  
![image-20240612-134107.png](../assets/donor-advised-funds-dafpay-by-chariot-integration/image-20240612-134107.png)
Example of DAFpay at checkout

Clicking the button at the bottom will launch the DAFpay checkout process.

The donor will be prompted to select their DAF provider and connect with their login credentials.  
![7E694564-1D36-4D82-AD47-411923243A85.png](../assets/donor-advised-funds-dafpay-by-chariot-integration/7E694564-1D36-4D82-AD47-411923243A85.png)

Once logged in, they can quickly and seamlessly complete their DAF payment.  
**DAFpay is a fast, safe, and secure payment method.** When you donate through DAFpay, your data is always safe and secure. Chariot's servers run on Amazon Web Services (AWS), which means top-of-the-line protection that evolves with the latest universal industry standards. Third parties will never have access to any of your donors' data, and the information you pass is fully encrypted using industry-vetted protocols.

Chariot's technology follows the same standards utilized for linking bank accounts to financial applications such as Venmo. No grants will ever be submitted without donor verification and consent, ensuring that you are fully in control of all your activity through the modal. Chariot prides itself first and foremost on security and is constantly ensuring that its security measures keep to the highest standards.

### FAQ

**Do I need a Chariot Deposit Account (CDA) to use DAFpay?**

In most cases, a CDA is not required to offer DAFpay. However, claiming and verifying your Chariot account is strongly recommended to help ensure gifts arrive without added delays or handling fees.

**Where will DAFpay appear for donors?**

DAFpay appears within the donation experience at checkout, embedded in your donation form flow.

**What is "Gift Processing" and do I need it?**

Gift Processing is a separate Chariot product. Most Gift Processing functionality is only available to nonprofits that sign up for a Chariot subscription, typically designed for larger nonprofits. If you're interested, contact Chariot to learn more.

**Additional Resources**

For further information, check out the below articles which go deeper into the DAF market and DAF donors.

[Breaking Down the Donor Advised Fund Market In 2022](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.givechariot.com/post/breaking-down-the-donor-advised-fund-market-in-2022&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1718805807008163&usg=AOvVaw3sNECphlS1gWIkOxpc75kA)

[Top 9 Takeaways for Nonprofits from the 2024 National Study on Donor Advised Funds](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.givechariot.com/post/top-9-takeaways-for-nonprofits-from-the-2024-national-study-on-donor-advised-funds&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1718805807008328&usg=AOvVaw3_ki52TzI_HONRq7Jt8zxK)

[Who uses a DAF?](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.givechariot.com/post/who-uses-a-daf&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1718805807008367&usg=AOvVaw3ug7oz6LwBG5g9B-IP_7MD)

[So... What is a DAF? Donor Advised Funds 101 for Fundraisers](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.givechariot.com/post/so-what-is-a-daf&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1718805807008399&usg=AOvVaw2RlxXel15DP4MboDs0ZTpw)

# One-time Giving Upsell Feature

As part of our**Embedded Donation Forms** , we've added an optional '**One-time Giving Upsell**' feature which allows you to encourage donors who select a one-time donation to change it to a recurring donation prior to completing their transaction.

While one-time donations may ebb and flow unpredictably, recurring gifts offer a consistent, trustworthy revenue stream, bolstering confident budgeting and foresighted planning.  
![image-20240705-153724.png](../assets/one-time-giving-upsell-feature/image-20240705-153724.png)

## Enabling the One-time Giving Upsell feature

When setting up Donation Amounts for your Embedded Donation Form, you will be given the option to enable the upsell feature.

Once you are on the Donation Amounts \& Types setup page (*Donation settings→ Donation amounts \& types*), follow the simple steps below:

1. Enable '**Accept Recurring Donations**', specify accepted donation types and minimum recurring amount.

   ![image-20240821-173334.png](../assets/one-time-giving-upsell-feature/image-20240821-173334.png)

2. Enable our recurring donation upsell feature by toggling on '**Encourage one-time donors to upgrade to recurring donations**'.

   ![image-20240705-145322.png](../assets/one-time-giving-upsell-feature/image-20240705-145322.png)
3. Click **Save**at the bottom of the page to confirm.

   ![image-20240705-154451.png](../assets/one-time-giving-upsell-feature/image-20240705-154451.png)

### Check out our One-time Giving Upsell feature in action in our sample workflow here!

[nonprofitsample.crowdchange.net](http://nonprofitsample.crowdchange.net/)

# Default User Notifications

As an Admin on your CrowdChange site, you are able to set the default state of notifications preferences for all new fundraiser owners. To do so, follow the simple steps below.

1. From any where on your CrowdChange site, click **Profile → Admin** in the top right corner.

2. Click **Communication Settings** on the left sidebar, then **Default User Notifications**.

3. You will see a notifications menu identical to the one in your profile notifications menu. However, any changes made here will affect all new users and any user that has not yet set their own preferences.

Users who have already set their own personal notifications preferences will not be affected.  
![default.png](../assets/default-user-notifications/default.png)

# New Fundraiser Dashboard

At CrowdChange, our mission has always been to empower nonprofits with the tools they need to drive impactful fundraising campaigns. Over the past year, we've gathered extensive feedback from you, our users, listened to your challenges, and observed how you interact with our platform. This update is the result of that feedback. We recognized the need for a more intuitive, user-friendly interface that not only simplifies navigation but also enhances your ability to manage and optimize your campaigns efficiently.  
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cxol5GkNCgI>

Based on your feedback, we've redesigned the user experience for fundraiser owners/admins to make managing your fundraising efforts easier and more intuitive than ever before. All the great fundraising features you know and love are still available and more accessible than ever via our new, streamlined layout.  
![image-20240823-185155.png](../assets/new-fundraiser-dashboard/image-20240823-185155.png)

**What's New?**

* **Enhanced Navigation:** Quickly access the tools and insights you need with our improved, streamlined navigation, helping you focus on maximizing your campaign's impact.

* **User-Friendly Design:** Our new dashboard layout is clean, organized, and tailored to give you quick access to key performance metrics, donor data, and essential management features.

* **Improved Performance:** Enjoy faster load times and a more responsive interface, ensuring you can manage your campaign with ease---whether at your desk or on the go.

## Revenue Stream Visualization

The fundraiser dashboard presents your revenue streams in a color-coded thermometer to clearly display the breakdown of funds raised, so you can have a better understanding of where your revenue is coming from.

Simply hover your mouse over a section of the thermometer to learn more.  
![image-20240813-201425.png](../assets/new-fundraiser-dashboard/image-20240813-201425.png)

## Enhanced Purchase Options UI

We've enhanced purchase options UI to make it easier than ever to manage your purchase options. **Sales Status**can now be controlled for all items, or within the details of a specific purchase option.  
![image (25).png](../assets/new-fundraiser-dashboard/image__25).png?cb=1504fc0173a443cf6c88ad692b8d517b)

## Updated Fundraiser Blocks UI

We've refreshed the design panel for all fundraiser blocks to make it easier for your campaign owners to navigate these settings and adjust Fundraiser and Blueprint design.  
![image-20240813-202036.png](../assets/new-fundraiser-dashboard/image-20240813-202036.png)

## New Blueprint Permission Controls

For partners using Blueprints, we've introduced new permission controls within Fundraiser Blocks Setup:  
![image-20240814-182935.png](../assets/new-fundraiser-dashboard/image-20240814-182935.png)

And introduced a new **Child Events Permissions**page to provide more in-depth control over what your fundraiser owners will have access to:  
![Screenshot 2024-08-14 143314-20240814-183328.png](../assets/new-fundraiser-dashboard/Screenshot_2024-08-14_143314-20240814-183328.png)

## Simplified Peer-to-Peer Page Management

We've combined Manage Teams and Personal Pages into one central space to provide better oversight and management capabilities.  
![image-20240813-205041.png](../assets/new-fundraiser-dashboard/image-20240813-205041.png)

We'll be sharing more details, including a quick guide to help you get familiar with the new dashboard features. Keep an eye on your inbox and in-app notifications for more information!

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo | Nav: Product Updates > Allow donors to a team to split their donation amongst personal pages within the team | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Allow donors to a team to split their donation amongst personal pages within the team

We offer an optional feature which can be enabled on your CrowdChange site called **Split Team Donations**.  
Please note that this feature is **NOT**enabled by default.

Reach out to your Partner Success Representative today to request it be enabled on your site!

Enabling this feature will allow donors making a donation to a team page (or a personal page within a team), to select single or multiple personal pages to apply their donation to, or auto-split it evenly amongst all personal pages connected to the team.

To enable this feature at the fundraiser level, follow the steps below:

1. Login to your fundraiser

2. Click **Manage fundraiser** in the top right corner.

3. Click **Donation settings** in the menu on the left.

4. Toggle on **Allow split donation on team members.**

   ![image-20250723-160918.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20250723-160918.png)

Here's how it looks in practice for the different user flows:

## Donating to a Team Page

1. Donor goes to a Team Page and clicks **Donate**.

   ![donate1.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/donate1.png)
2. Donor selects **General Donation.**

   ![general.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/general.png)
3. Donor selects a donation amount and an auto-split is applied to split the donation evenly across all personal pages within the team. Donor can click **Adjust**if desired to edit split amounts.

   ![don11.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/don11.png)
4. If desired, the donor clicks the **Adjust**button and sets specific amounts for each page.

   ![image-20240710-155929.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20240710-155929.png)

## Donating to a specific Personal Page

### Via Team → Donate → Donate to a Page

1. Donor goes to a Team Page and clicks **Donate**.

   ![donate1.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/donate1.png)
2. Donor selects **Donate to a page**.

   ![donate to a page.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/donate_to_a_page.png)
3. Donor selects the page they'd like to support.

   ![francis.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/francis.png)
4. Donor is given the option to split the donation between multiple pages, as opposed to donating solely to the specific page.

   ![split1.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/split1.png)
5. If **Split donation** is clicked, the user will be prompted to select which personal pages the donation should be split amongst and click **Next**.

   ![image-20240710-163707.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20240710-163707.png)
6. At checkout, an auto-split is applied to split the donation evenly across all selected personal pages within the team. Donor can click **Adjust**if desired to edit split amounts.

   ![image-20240710-163834.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20240710-163834.png)
7. If desired, the donor clicks the **Adjust**button and sets specific amounts for each page.

   ![image-20240710-163958.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20240710-163958.png)

### Via Page → Donate

1. Donor goes to a Personal Page and clicks **Donate**.

   ![donatebtn.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/donatebtn.png)
2. Donor selects a donation amount and clicks **Split Donation**.

   ![splitz.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/splitz.png)
3. Donor selects the other personal page(s) they would like to split the donation between and clicks **Next**.

   ![image-20240808-161951.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20240808-161951.png)
4. An auto-split is applied to split the donation evenly across all selected personal pages within the team. Donor can click **Adjust**if desired to edit split amounts.

   ![image-20240808-162054.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20240808-162054.png)
5. If desired, the donor clicks the **Adjust**button and sets specific amounts for each page.

   ![image-20240808-162146.png](../assets/allow-donors-to-a-team-to-split-their-donation-amo/image-20240808-162146.png)

## Additional Information

### Refunds

When transaction is refunded (or disputed), all split amounts are refunded.

### Personal Page Deletion

If one of the personal pages is deleted- the donated amount will remain in the team.

### Moving Transactions Feature

Transactions that use the split donations feature **cannot** be moved to different fundraisers and **cannot** be partially refunded. If such a change needs to be made, the transaction must be fully refunded and re-done.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv | Nav: Access Codes for Purchase Options (Pre-Sale or Private Tickets, Merchandise, Registration, and Sponsorship) | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Access Codes for Purchase Options (Pre-Sale or Private Tickets, Merchandise, Registration, and Sponsorship)

**Access Codes** is a feature that allows you to gate access to purchase options (tickets, apparel and merchandise, registration, or sponsorships) behind a password. This can allow you to have separate, specialized purchase tiers that are only accessible to those who have been given a specific code. This can be used for:

* Pre-Sale Codes

* Special Discounted Purchase Tiers

* Staff or Friends and Family Purchase Tiers

The **Access Codes**feature is currently in beta, and therefore is not available on CrowdChange by default. If your organization does not have access to this feature, and feel like it would be a worthwhile addition to your site, speak to your Partner Success Manager to discuss adding this function.

*** ** * ** ***

**Access Codes** are turned on via the **Purchase Options** menu within the **Fundraiser Dashboard** . To enable this option for any purchase options, simply toggle it on under *Additional Features*.

To do this, please follow these steps:

* Go to your fundraiser (please ensure you are logged in)

* Click **Manage my fundraiser** to access the **Fundraiser Dashboard**

* From the Fundraiser Dashboard, click **Purchase options**

* In the *Additional features* section, toggle on **Access codes**

* Below the Access codes toggle, click Save to save your settings

![image-20250508-142339.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-142339.png)
\<p\>Toggle on \<strong\>Access codes\</strong\> in the \<em\>Additional features\</em\> section of the \<strong\>Purchase options \</strong\>menu\</p\>

Once this function is toggled on, you can **Assign access codes**to any existing Purchase Option tiers:  
![image-20250508-142753.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-142753.png)
\<p\>Click \<strong\>Assign access codes\</strong\> to set up a new code\</p\>

Once you click **Assign access codes** , you will be prompted to either enter or generate a new code. If you select **Generate**, a random code will be created. Once you have established your code, you can choose whether to assign this code to all purchase tiers, or select the tiers that this code will apply to.  
![image-20250508-143305.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-143305.png)
\<p\>Apply your Access Code to the desired tiers that you would like to gate behind a password\</p\>

Once you have selected your purchase tiers, click **Apply** to save your changes.

*** ** * ** ***

You can also assign an **Access code** to a purchase option within the individual purchase option tier setup page - this is also accessible when creating a new tier.  
![image-20250508-143531.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-143531.png)
\<p\>The \<strong\>Access codes \</strong\>function is available on a tier-by-tier basis for all Purchase Options\</p\>

*** ** * ** ***

Once your code is in place, if a user attempts to select the Purchase Option in question, they will see a field to input a password to access the desired Purchase Option.  
![image-20250508-143817.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-143817.png)

If there are both public tiers and limited access tiers, users can select where to browse using the options in the menu header . If all purchase tiers require an access code, users will only see the Limited Access menu, shown above. Once the user inputs the correct code, the limited access tiers will be made available to them.  
![image-20250508-144010.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-144010.png)

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options | Nav: Per-transaction Limits for Purchase Options | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Per-transaction Limits for Purchase Options

You can now set limits on the number of items a supporter can purchase in a single transaction - perfect for enforcing rules like "2 tickets per person" or "limit 1 hoodie per order."

This feature can be used for:

* **Tickets**

* **Registration**

* **Apparel \& merchandise**

## How it works

When a quantity limit is set, users will not be able to add more than that number of the selected item to their cart. This is especially useful for capacity control or limiting availability of high-demand items.

### How to Set a Limit

1. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top-right.

2. From the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

3. Choose one of the following categories:

   * **Tickets**

   * **Registration**

   * **Apparel \& Merchandise**

4. Click on the item you wish to edit (or create a new one).

5. Find the field labeled **Limit per transaction** and enter the desired number.

   *(Leave this blank for unlimited.)*

6. Click **Save**.

📸 *See screenshot example below from the Tickets section:*  
![image-20250902-180920.png](../assets/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options/image-20250902-180920.png)
**Limit per transaction** settings within the **Tickets** section of the **Fundraiser dashboard**

*** ** * ** ***

**Limits can be set individually per item** - for example, you could allow 5 tickets per transaction, but only 1 hoodie.  
![image-20250902-182053.png](../assets/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options/image-20250902-182053.png)
**Limit per transaction** settings within an individual **Ticket** type

If an item has **variations** (like sizes), the limit applies **across all variations**. For example, a limit of 2 would allow the user to purchase 1 Small + 1 Medium, but not 3 of any combination.

*** ** * ** ***

Limits can also be applied per transaction to individual **variations** of a specific purchase option item - meaning you could limit popular sizes of a merchandise item if stock is low.  
![image-20250903-144638.png](../assets/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options/image-20250903-144638.png)
**Limit per transaction** settings shown at the Purchase Option Item **Variation**level

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/link-by-stripe-in-crowdchange-checkout | Nav: Link by Stripe in CrowdChange Checkout | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Link by Stripe in CrowdChange Checkout

CrowdChange works with different payment processors depending on the needs of your organization. If you have any questions about which payment processor is right for your organization, don't hesitate to reach out to your Partner Success Representative to discuss your options.

CrowdChange checkout forms now include **Link by Stripe**, a secure feature from Stripe designed to make online checkout faster and more convenient.

*** ** * ** ***

## What is Link?

Link is a payment option provided by Stripe, one of the payment processors used on the CrowdChange platform. It allows donors and registrants to save their payment and contact details (such as card number, email, and phone number) so they can check out more quickly in the future.

Once saved, this information can autofill whenever the supporter checks out on any other site that also uses Link, including CrowdChange. To confirm their identity, Stripe sends a one-time code by email or text before details are filled in.

*** ** * ** ***

### What Supporters See

At checkout, supporters will see an **optional box** inviting them to "Save my information for faster checkout."  
![image-20250903-150242.png](../assets/link-by-stripe-in-crowdchange-checkout/image-20250903-150242.png)
Optional **Link** by Stripe elements shown to new users on checkout page

* Choosing this option saves their information securely with Stripe for future use.

* If they prefer not to, they can simply leave the box unchecked and continue as usual.

*** ** * ** ***

### Key Benefits

* **Optional for donors**: Saving information is never required. Supporters can always complete checkout without using Link.

* **Faster future checkouts**: If opted in, payment details are securely stored and can be reused in seconds.

* **Secure and trusted**: Link is fully managed by Stripe, a leading global payment processor, with encryption and strong authentication built in.

* **Works across Stripe sites**: Saved details can be used on any checkout that offers Link, not just CrowdChange.

*** ** * ** ***

### What This Means for Admins

* Link is automatically included in Stripe-powered checkouts on CrowdChange.

* No setup or configuration is required by admins.

* There are no additional fees or changes to your site's payment processing.

# How to Access and Use the Tax Receipts Report

The **Tax Receipts Report** allows Admin users to view, manage, and take action on all issued tax receipts across your CrowdChange site. This report is designed to help you quickly find receipts, re-send them to donors, void them, or issue replacements.

*** ** * ** ***

## Accessing the Tax Receipts Report

To access this report:

1. Log in to your CrowdChange site.

2. Click **Profile** in the top right corner, then select **Admin**.

3. In the left-hand menu, click **Reports** , then **Tax Receipts Report**.

![image-20250925-151327.png](../assets/how-to-access-and-use-the-tax-receipts-report/image-20250925-151327.png)
A view of the Tax Receipts Report within the Admin Dashboard

*** ** * ** ***

### What You Can Do in the Tax Receipts Report

Once inside the report, you'll be able to:

* **Search** for specific receipts using filters such as date range, fundraiser, donor name, or email.

* **Download**:

  * A detailed **CSV file** of all issued tax receipts within your selected date range.

  * A **ZIP archive** containing all PDF copies of the receipts in your filtered view.

* **Re-send Receipts** to the original recipient or to a new email address.

* **Void** a tax receipt (for example, if a donation was refunded or incorrect).

* **Re-issue** a corrected version of a receipt if any donor details need updating.

> For more details on re-issuing tax receipts, see our article: How to Re-Issue a Tax Receipt .

*** ** * ** ***

#### Batch Actions

You can also take action on multiple receipts at once using the checkboxes in the report:

* **Resend multiple receipts** to their original recipients.

* **Download selected receipts** as a bulk ZIP archive.

* **Void multiple receipts** at once if needed.

This makes it easy to handle year-end summaries, campaign follow-ups, or corrections in bulk.  
![image-20250925-152649.png](../assets/how-to-access-and-use-the-tax-receipts-report/image-20250925-152649.png)
Available Batch Actions in the Tax Receipts Report

*** ** * ** ***

#### Important Notes

* This report only displays **receipts that have already been issued**. Transactions that have not yet generated a receipt (due to ineligibility, minimum threshold not met, or being in a pending state) will not appear.

* Voided receipts are marked as such in the system and on the PDF itself.

* Re-issuing a receipt will **automatically void** the original version.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-upload-a-list-of-teams-or-personal-pages-us | Nav: How to Upload a List of Teams or Personal Pages Using a CSV File | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Upload a List of Teams or Personal Pages Using a CSV File

CrowdChange allows you to upload multiple Team or Personal Fundraising Pages in bulk using a simple .CSV file. This feature is available within the **Manage Pages and Teams** section of your fundraiser dashboard.

## Step 1: Go to Manage Pages and Teams

1. Log in to your CrowdChange site.

2. Navigate to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. From the left sidebar, click **Manage pages and teams**.

You will see two tabs at the top of this screen (see below):  
![image-20251125-163938.png](../assets/how-to-upload-a-list-of-teams-or-personal-pages-us/image-20251125-163938.png)
View of the **Manage pages \& teams** feature

* **Teams**

* **Personal Pages**

**Be sure to click into the correct tab before uploading**, depending on whether you are uploading team pages or personal pages.

*** ** * ** ***

### Step 2: Download and Fill Out the Correct Template

Click the **Upload .csv file** button to initiate this process. To download the template, click **Download template.csv**(see below).  
![image-20251125-164155.png](../assets/how-to-upload-a-list-of-teams-or-personal-pages-us/image-20251125-164155.png)
View of how to download the .csv template for **Team fundraising pages**

Ensure that the **column headers are not changed**, and that all required fields are filled out. For example:

* **For Personal Pages:** Email, First Name, Last Name, Page Name, Fundraising Goal (optional depending on Fundraiser settings), and Team ID (optional if not linked to a team).

* **For Teams:** Email, First Name, Last Name, Page Name, Fundraising Goal (optional depending on Fundraiser settings).

*** ** * ** ***

### Step 3: Upload Your CSV

1. Click **Upload .csv file** in the top right.

2. Drag and drop your completed CSV or browse to select it.

3. Review the summary before confirming the upload.

**Important:** All rows are treated as new entries. Duplicates will not be merged, and the import cannot be undone once it begins.

*** ** * ** ***

### Finding the Team ID (For Personal Page Uploads Only)

If you are uploading personal pages and want them linked to teams, you must include the **Team ID**.

You can find the Team ID in two places:

* **Admin Teams Report:** This report shows a list of all teams and their unique IDs.

* **Team Page URL:** Visit the team page and copy the numeric value at the end of the URL.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/how-to-mass-upload-offline-donations-using-a-csv-f | Nav: How to Mass Upload Offline Donations Using a CSV File | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Mass Upload Offline Donations Using a CSV File

You can now upload multiple offline donations at once using our CSV upload tool. This feature is helpful when you have collected several cash or cheque donations offline and want to add them quickly to your fundraiser in CrowdChange.

*** ** * ** ***

## How to Access the CSV Upload Tool

1. Go to your fundraiser on your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Manage fundraiser** in the top-right corner.

3. In the fundraiser dashboard menu, select **Offline donations**.

4. Click the **Upload .csv file** button.

A modal will appear where you can download the CSV template and upload your completed file.  
![image-20251125-165945.png](../assets/how-to-mass-upload-offline-donations-using-a-csv-f/image-20251125-165945.png)
A view of the .csv upload tool feature, with the **Upload .csv file** button highlighted

*** ** * ** ***

## Step 1: Download the CSV Template

Before uploading, download the required template and fill it in. You can download the template by clicking **Download template.csv** in the above-pictured modal.

Do not rename or change any column headers, as this may prevent your file from being processed.  
**Important:**All rows in the CSV will be treated as new donations. Duplicate entries will not be merged. Once the upload begins, it cannot be paused or cancelled.

*** ** * ** ***

## Step 2: Upload Your File

1. Open the **Upload .csv file** modal.

2. Drag and drop your completed CSV into the upload area, or click **Upload file** to select it.

3. Review the summary on screen.

4. Click **Import** to complete the upload.

*** ** * ** ***

## What Happens After Upload

### Donation Status

All uploaded offline donations will be created with the status **Pending** by default.

Pending offline donations:

* Do appear in the Admin-level donations report, but their status will be indicated as **Pending**.

* Do appear as pending contributions on the fundraiser dashboard for admins and hosts.

To confirm an offline donation:

* Open the donation entry from **Offline donations**.

* Change the status to **Received**.

### Tax Receipts

Tax receipts are **not** automatically issued for offline donations uploaded via CSV.

If your organization issues tax receipts:

* Receipts must be issued **manually** , after upload, **one donation at a time**.

* Tax receipts can only be issued on offline donations that are marked as **Received**.

* This can be done from the donation's details page or through the Tax Receipts Report, depending on your site's configuration.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations- | Nav: Leaderboard Block - How to show a list of donations, team fundraising pages and personal fundraising pages on your fundraiser | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Leaderboard Block - How to show a list of donations, team fundraising pages and personal fundraising pages on your fundraiser

The **Leaderboard block** is available by default on all fundraisers, and can show a list of **Donations** , **Team fundraising pages** , and **Personal fundraising pages** depending on your required settings. This is a customizable and dynamic element of the fundraiser user interface, and can be used as a critical part of your online campaigns.

*** ** * ** ***

## How to edit the **Leaderboard block**

To edit the **Leaderboard block**, follow the below steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

![image-20251127-144347.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-144347.png)
View of the **Leaderboard block** with the **Edit** button highlighted

*** ** * ** ***

## How to add a **Leaderboard block**

If your fundraiser is missing a leaderboard block, it is possible it was previously deleted. To restore or add a second leaderboard block, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Within the user interface, between any two blocks, click the **Plus** icon

* The list of available blocks will then be shown - select the **Leaderboard block**

![image-20251127-144841.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-144841.png)
After clicking the **Plus** icon, select the **Leaderboard block**from the list to add this element

*** ** * ** ***

## Display options - how to show different leaderboards on Fundraiser, Team, and Personal Pages

The **Leaderboard block** can be shown, or hidden, on different areas of your fundraiser depending on your needs. Using the **Display options** function, you can decide if a leaderboard is visible on the main **Fundraiser page** , on a **Team page** , or on a **Personal fundraising page**. This functionality also allows you to have different leaderboards, with different settings, shown in these various places.

To adjust the **Leaderboard block** 's **Display options**, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

* Click the **Display options** button

* You then can check off where you want this **Leaderboard block** to be featured

![image-20251127-150532.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-150532.png)

As multiple **Leaderboard** **blocks** can be added to a single fundraiser, this can allow you to have, for example, a list of **Recent donations** on the main fundraiser page, but a list of **Top donations** shown on Team or Personal fundraising pages.

*** ** * ** ***

## **Leaderboard block** layout - how to adjust the order leaderboard elements are shown

By default, the **Leaderboard block** will show donations first, followed by Team fundraising pages, then Personal fundraising pages. This order, however, can be adjusted within the **Leaderboard block**'s edit functionality. To adjust this, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

* Click the **Pencil icon**

* On the item you want to move, click the dots beside the **Donations** , **Teams** , or **Personal pages** and drag it to the desired new placement

* Once you are finished, click **Save**

![image-20251127-151648.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-151648.png)
Drag the highlighted icon to move the placement of your **Leaderboard block** options

Whichever option is listed first will be what is shown by default on your fundraiser publicly.

*** ** * ** ***

## Setting up each tab of your **Leaderboard block**

Each element of the leaderboard block can be uniquely customized. To customize any of these elements, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

* Click the **Pencil icon**

* On the element you would like to customize, click **Set up**

![image-20251127-152307.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-152307.png)
The **Set up** option for **Donations** , **Teams** , and **Personal pages**

Additionally, any of these options can be hidden, if required, by toggling off the slider within each box.

### Donations

Within the **Donations**section, you can adjust the following items:

* **Title** - This allows you to adjust what this tab of your **Leaderboard block** is called.

* **Sorting** - here you can select whether or not to show your donations by **Top** (highest value donations listed first), or **Recent** (most recent donations shown first)

* **What information to show**

  * **Donation amount** - Here you can set the leaderboard to show donation values (default setting), or to hide these amounts. If hidden, the list will only show the donor's selected display name, but no donation value will be shown.

  * **Progress bar** - Here you can set whether or not **progress bars** are shown for personal and team pages

![image-20260908-180410.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20260908-180410.png)
**Show goal progress bar** functionality within the **Leaderboard block**

* **Comment** - Here you can set whether or not optional comments made at the point of donation are shown (default settings) or hidden.

  * **Icons** - Here you can enable icons for various purchase options and types (**Apparel purchase** ,**Recurring donations** ,**Ticket purchase** ,**Sponsorship purchase** , **eCards purchase** ,and **Registration purchase**). These icons are pictured below.

![image-20251127-153510.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-153510.png)
View of the **Icons** options within the **Leaderboard block**

* **Date conditions** - Here you can specify which transactions are shown using specific date periods.

* **Amount raised conditions** - This function can be used to hide donations from the leaderboard that either do not meet, or exceed, specific donation value.

### Teams

* **Title** - This allows you to adjust what this tab of your **Leaderboard block** is called.

* **Sorting** - here you can select whether or not to show your donations by **Top** (highest value total page donations listed first), or **Recent** (most recently created Teams shown first)

* **What information to show**

  * **Donation amount** - Here you can set whether or not the Leaderboard block displays the total raised by the Team Fundraising Page

* **Date conditions** - Here you can specify which teams are shown using specific date periods. This is based on the creation date of the Team.

* **Amount raised conditions** - This function can be used to hide teams from the leaderboard that either do not meet, or exceed, specific total donation value.

### Personal pages

* **Title** - This allows you to adjust what this tab of your **Leaderboard block** is called.

* **Sorting** - here you can select whether or not to show your Personal pages by **Top** (highest value total page donations listed first), or **Recent** (most recently created pages shown first)

* **What information to show**

  * **Donation amount** - Here you can set whether or not the Leaderboard block displays the total raised by the Personal Fundraising Page.

* **Date conditions** - Here you can specify which pages are shown using specific date periods. This is based on the creation date of the page.

* **Amount raised conditions** - This function can be used to hide pages from the leaderboard that either do not meet, or exceed, specific total donation value.

*** ** * ** ***

## **Item display type** settings

The **Item display type** settings allow you to decide how the various entries in your **Leaderboard block** are displayed. There are two options as to how this is displayed, each with their own settings.

* **Standard** - This is the default setting for the **Leaderboard block** . This is the standardized list of Donations, Teams, and Personal pages. You can select as few as **one** and as many as **ten** items to display on this list at a time. Please note that the **View all**button at the bottom of the leaderboard will always be available (unless manually turned off), so all donors, teams, and pages will still be accessible, even if your total number of these items exceeds your list options.

* **Scrollable list** - This option allows your leaderboard to be scrollable, allowing for a longer list, that takes up less room. The **Auto-scroll animation** option causes the leaderboard to automatically scroll through entries, injecting some dynamic animation into your fundraiser.

*** ** * ** ***

## The **View all** button

The **View all** button allows users to browse entries within the leaderboard that fall outside of the settings assigned in the **Item display type** settings section. If you only want to show the options set in this area, you can uncheck the box beside the **Show "View all" button** option.  
![image-20251127-160857.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-160857.png)
You can turn off the **View all**button by toggling this function off

*** ** * ** ***

## Appearance

You can adjust the colors of your **Leaderboard block** within the **Appearance** section. By default, the fundraiser's theme settings are used here.  
![image-20251127-161210.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-161210.png)
Colors are assigned using hex codes, or using the color picker

*** ** * ** ***

## **Content** option - how to change the title of your **Leaderboard block**

The **Content** option allows you to change the title of your **Leaderboard block** . You can also change this by clicking the title within the user interface. If changes are made here, please ensure you click **Save** after the fact.  
![image-20251127-161450.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-161450.png)
**Leaderboard block** title can be adjusted either by clicking the title in the user interface, or by using the **Content** section of the **Leaderboard Block** 's **Edit** module

*** ** * ** ***

## Reactions - how to allow emoji reactions on Leaderboard donations

The **Reactions** setting allows visitors to add emoji reactions to donations shown in the **Donations** tab of your Leaderboard block. When enabled, each donation card will display reaction icons (with counts) and an option to add a reaction, helping supporters engage with and celebrate donations publicly.  
![image-20260304-160806.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20260304-160806.png)
The **Leaderboard block** with **Reactions** enabled

### How to enable Reactions

To turn on Reactions for donations, follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard** block, and click the **Edit** button

* Under **Donations** , click **Set up**

* Scroll to **What information to show**

* Check the box beside **Reactions**

* Click **Save**

### How to disable Reactions

If you would like to remove reactions from donation cards, return to the same menu and uncheck **Reactions** , then click **Save**.

*** ** * ** ***

## Customizing the **View all** button

You can customize how the **View all** button shows up at the bottom of your leaderboard by clicking **"View all" button style**. Here you can choose whether it is the default text, matches primary buttons throughout your fundraiser, or is outlined as per your color selection within this area.  
![image-20260908-180646.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20260908-180646.png)

# How to Assign Tickets to Different Attendees During Checkout

Our "Assign Tickets During Checkout" feature makes it easier than ever for purchasers to distribute individual tickets to multiple attendees in a single transaction. This is ideal for group purchases and improves the check-in experience at your event.

*** ** * ** ***

## Enabling the Feature

To enable this setting for your fundraiser:

1. Log in to your CrowdChange site.

2. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. In the left-hand menu, click **Purchase Options** , then select **Tickets**.

4. Scroll to the **Assign tickets during checkout** option and toggle it **ON**.

5. Click **Save** at the bottom of the page to apply your changes.

![image-20260115-155018.png](../assets/how-to-assign-tickets-to-different-attendees-durin/image-20260115-155018.png)
View of the **Assign tickets during checkout**feature being toggled on

Once enabled, users will be able to assign a name and email address to each ticket during the checkout process.

*** ** * ** ***

### How It Works for Ticket purchasers

When a ticket purchaser selects more than one ticket at checkout, they will see a new step where they can assign each ticket individually.

* Required fields: **First Name** , **Last Name** , and **Email**

* Optional fields: **Phone Number** and any **Custom Questions** you've added

* Donors can select "Same as previous" to speed up entry if multiple tickets are for the same person

![image-20260115-155309.png](../assets/how-to-assign-tickets-to-different-attendees-durin/image-20260115-155309.png)
View of **Assign ticket**button on checkout page

*** ** * ** ***

### How Tickets Are Delivered

Each assigned attendee will receive their ticket via email, along with the following:

* A **PDF ticket attachment** (for printing or saving)

* A button to add the tickets to your **Apple Wallet** or **Google Wallet**

* A **QR code** embedded directly in the email for quick scanning at the event

The purchaser will also receive a full summary email containing all ticket details, including copies of each assigned ticket.

*** ** * ** ***

### Reporting \& Admin Access

To view assigned ticket data:

1. Log in to your CrowdChange site.

2. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage fundraiser**.

3. Click **Reports** on the left-hand menu

4. Select **Tickets report**

The report will include each ticket holder's name, email, phone (if collected), and their assigned ticket(s).

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/sign-in-with-apple-why-does-a-users-email-appear-a | Nav: Sign in with Apple - Why does a user’s email appear as xxxx@privaterelay.appleid.com? | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Sign in with Apple - Why does a user’s email appear as xxxx@privaterelay.appleid.com?

If you see an email address like `abcd1234@privaterelay.appleid.com`, the user signed in using **Sign in with Apple** and chose the **Hide My Email** option.

This is expected behavior and is part of Apple's privacy protection feature.  
![image-20260303-154006.png](../assets/sign-in-with-apple-why-does-a-users-email-appear-a/image-20260303-154006.png)
View of the login page with **Continue with Apple** highlighted

*** ** * ** ***

## What is Hide My Email?

When users sign in with Apple, they can choose to share either:

* Their real email address, or

* A private relay email address generated by Apple

If they select **Hide My Email** , Apple creates a unique, random email address ending in `@privaterelay.appleid.com`.

*** ** * ** ***

### How the private relay works

* Apple generates a unique relay email for that specific app or platform.

* Emails sent to that relay address are automatically forwarded to the user's real email inbox.

* The user's actual email address is never shared with CrowdChange.

This means the relay address is valid and functional, even though it does not look like a typical email address.

*** ** * ** ***

### Can we contact the user?

Yes. You can send emails to the `@privaterelay.appleid.com` address as usual. Apple will forward the message to the user's real email address.

The relay address will continue to work as long as the user keeps Sign in with Apple enabled for CrowdChange.

<!-- Source: https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/design-your-fundraiser-how-to-adjust-the-front-end | Nav: Design your Fundraiser - How to adjust the front-end user interface of your campaign on CrowdChange | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Design your Fundraiser - How to adjust the front-end user interface of your campaign on CrowdChange

## Designing Your Fundraiser with Blocks

CrowdChange gives you full control over the look, feel, and structure of your fundraiser through our flexible **block-based design system**.

Every fundraiser page is built using individual content "Blocks." Each block represents a specific section or feature of your page, such as your donation progress, text content, leaderboard, registration options, or sharing tools. This modular structure allows you to fully customize the front-end experience without affecting the core functionality of your fundraiser.

Using the **Design Your Fundraiser** tool, you can:

* Add new blocks to highlight key content

* Edit existing blocks to update text, layout, or display settings

* Reorder blocks to control the flow of your page

* Hide or remove blocks that are not relevant to your campaign

* Customize layout styles, images, background settings, and button visibility

Because the page is built block-by-block, you can tailor your fundraiser to match your organization's branding, campaign goals, and audience needs. Personal and Team fundraising pages will automatically inherit the overall visual style of the main fundraiser, ensuring a consistent and professional appearance across your campaign.

This flexible structure makes it easy to create anything from a simple donation page to a fully featured event with tickets, registrations, merchandise, sponsorships, peer-to-peer fundraising, and more, all while maintaining complete design control.

*** ** * ** ***

## How to access **Design your fundraiser** functionality

To access the **Design your fundraiser** functionality, please follow the below steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log in**

* Access your fundraiser and click **Manage fundraiser** in the upper right-hand corner of your campaigns' cover image

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

![image-20260303-160053.png](../assets/design-your-fundraiser-how-to-adjust-the-front-end/image-20260303-160053.png)
The **Design your fundraiser** button within the **Fundraiser dashboard**

*** ** * ** ***

## Fundraiser blocks overview

Below is an overview of the core blocks available within the **Design Your Fundraiser** tool, along with a brief description of each.

* **Cover Image Block** - Displays your fundraiser's main banner or hero image at the top of the page, allowing you to upload, edit, and customize the visual header that defines your campaign's look and feel.

* **Sharing Block** - Provides built-in sharing tools including social media options, QR code generation, and direct link copying, making it easy for supporters to promote your fundraiser.

* **Donation Progress Block** - Showcases your total amount raised, progress toward your goal, donor count, and optionally team and personal page totals, helping drive momentum and transparency.

* **Text Block** - Allows you to add custom headings and body content to share important details, storytelling, sponsor recognition, or calls to action.

* **Join Fundraiser Block** - Displays the option for participants to join the fundraiser and create personal or team fundraising pages, and provides quick access to pages already created by a logged-in user.

* **Purchase Option Blocks (Tickets, Registration, Apparel \& Merchandise, Sponsors, eCards, Tribute Cards)** - Highlights your enabled purchase options in dedicated sections, allowing supporters to quickly view and complete transactions related to event tickets, registrations, merchandise, sponsorship packages, and card purchases.

* **Leaderboard Block** - Displays Top or Recent Donations, Top Teams, and Top Personal Pages to encourage friendly competition and recognize supporter contributions.

* **Gallery Block** - Showcases multiple images in a gallery or slideshow format, helping you visually highlight your cause, past events, or campaign impact.

* **Customer Support Block** - Displays a "Contact Us" button that opens a support form, allowing visitors to quickly reach out with questions or inquiries related to your fundraiser.

# Cover Image Block - How to update the banner image on your fundraiser

The Cover image block (also referred to as the banner or hero image) appears at the top of your fundraiser and is one of the most visible elements of your public-facing page. It helps set the tone for your campaign and supports your branding.  
![image-20260303-163955.png](../assets/cover-image-block-how-to-update-the-banner-image-o/image-20260303-163955.png)
View of the **Cover image block** using the **Fullscreen** layout on a fundraiser

*** ** * ** ***

## How to edit the Cover image block

To edit the Cover image block, follow the below steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Hover over the fundraiser's current cover image and click **Edit**

* On the right sidebar that appears, scroll down and expand the **Content** section

* Click the pencil icon to change the current image

* Select the new image from your computer, crop and edit if desired, and click **Save**

* At the bottom of the sidebar, click **Save** to confirm and publish your changes

![image-20260303-165019.png](../assets/cover-image-block-how-to-update-the-banner-image-o/image-20260303-165019.png)
The **Edit** button on the **Cover image block** within the **Design your fundraiser** function

*** ** * ** ***

## Cover image block layouts

Within the **Layout** section of the Cover image block, you can choose how your banner image is displayed at the top of your fundraiser. Each layout option offers a slightly different visual presentation to match your campaign style. Once a layout is selected, images are then added in the **Content** section. Below is a list of the potential layouts used in the **Cover image block**.

* **Full screen** (default) - Displays your cover image across the full width of the page in a bold, immersive hero format. This layout is ideal for high-impact visuals and branding-focused campaigns.

* **Gallery** - Allows you to upload multiple images that rotate in a slideshow format, creating a dynamic and engaging visual experience for visitors.

* **Centered** - Displays the image in a more contained format with content centered on the page, offering a balanced and structured look.

* **Sideway** - Positions the image beside your key content instead of above it, creating a split-layout design. This layout can be aligned left or right.

Each image format has different recommended dimensions - these are listed below. Please note that regardless of Layout settings, the **mobile** version of your cover image remains the same.  

| **Cover image format** | **Dimensions** |
|------------------------|----------------|
| Full screen            | 1920x699       |
| Gallery                | 1920x699       |
| Centered               | 1228x420       |
| Sideway                | 1056x1000      |
| Mobile                 | 750x480        |

*** ** * ** ***

### Using a video in place of your Cover Image

You can use an externally hosted **Video** on your fundraiser in place of your **Cover image** . CrowdChange can host videos, or live streams hosted on **Youtube** , **Vimeo** , or **Twitch** . Please note that these videos must be available publicly in order to show up on your page - they cannot be private. Unlisted videos are supported as long as the link is accessible to all. **Livestream links** , as well as **Youtube Shorts** are both supported via the **Cover image block**.

If you choose to feature a video on your page, it will automatically play upon accessing the fundraiser - the video will be muted, unless the user clicks on it, in which case it will popup over the screen, and play with sound.

While this replaces your cover image on the fundraiser page, the fundraiser tile on the main CrowdChange site, and meta images (for sharing on social media and other sources) are still drawn from the Cover Image, so please ensure you still have something added in this area.

*** ** * ** ***

### Customizing Buttons

You can adjust what **buttons** are displayed within the **Cover image block** , what text is shown on each button, and how each button is displayed on **mobile devices** , as well as on **Personal** and **Team fundraising pages**.

To access this element of the **Cover image block**, follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Hover over the fundraiser's current cover image and click **Edit**

* On the right sidebar that appears, scroll down and expand the **Buttons** section

Once you have expanded the **Buttons** section, you can edit each individual button. You are able to:

* Adjust the text on each button (for example, you could change *Tickets* to display *Buy tickets*)

* Decide which button is shown in which order by dragging and dropping the button up or down

* Decide if a button is always shown on mobile (by default the first button will be shown, and other options will be hidden behind an expandable menu - this is for space saving purposes

* Adjust whether or not the button is **Filled** or **Outlined**

* On Personal and Team Pages, you can choose whether or not a button is shown at all, and if it is shown, whether or not the settings shown on the main fundraiser page are adopted, or unique settings are applied

================================================================================

# Sharing Block - Social media, QR Codes, Email, SMS, and more

The **Sharing block** allows users to share **Fundraisers** , **Team pages** , and **Personal pages** across a variety of social media platforms. This also allows users to send pre-written **email** and **SMS messages** , **as well as generate unique QR codes** for Fundraisers, Team pages and Personal pages.  
![image-20260303-205341.png](../assets/sharing-block-social-media-qr-codes-email-sms-and-/image-20260303-205341.png)
The **Sharing block** is shown above, with options for **Facebook** , **X** , **LinkedIn** , **WhatsApp** , **QR Code** generation, **SMS** , **Email** , **Link** copy and paste, and **Share with other options** displayed

Fundraiser owners can determine which of the above-mentioned options are shown using the **Design your fundraiser** functionality - to edit the **Sharing block**, follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Hover over the **Sharing block** and click **Edit**

* On the right sidebar that appears, scroll down and expand the **Layout** section

* Here you can decide what is shown in your Sharing block

* At the bottom of the sidebar, click **Save** to confirm and publish your changes

![image-20260303-205705.png](../assets/sharing-block-social-media-qr-codes-email-sms-and-/image-20260303-205705.png)
The **Edit** area of the **Sharing block**

You can also decide how these icons are displayed, as well as the text shown on the Sharing block, as well as background settings.

*** ** * ** ***

The **Sharing block** allows users to share using the following social media platforms:

* Facebook

* X (formerly Twitter)

* LinkedIn

* WhatsApp

If these options are selected, users will be prompted to either use a pre-written sharing message, which can be copied and pasted, or to write their own message. Once this is decided, the user will be taken directly to the social media platform selected. Please note that without an account on the social media platform in question, posts cannot be shared.

*** ** * ** ***

The **SMS** and **Email** functionality within the **Sharing block** allows users to send text messages and emails directly from CrowdChange, with no requirement to log in to their email account or link a phone number to the platform. These messages are templated, and are not editable by the users.  
![image-20260303-210100.png](../assets/sharing-block-social-media-qr-codes-email-sms-and-/image-20260303-210100.png)
An example of the pre-written **Email** option using the **Sharing block**  
At this time these messages are predetermined by CrowdChange and are not adjustable. For more detailed email messages, please use the **Mailing List**function
